string_8: \"Even a lawless land needs rules. Even anarchy requires order.\" \r\n- Kylian Cyaxan
undefined (French): « Même une terre sans foi ni loi a besoin de règles. Même l'anarchie a besoin d'ordre. » — Kylian Cyaxan
undefined (German): \"Selbst ein gesetzloses Land braucht Regeln. Selbst die Anarchie verlangt nach Ordnung.\" \r\n– Kylian Cyaxan
undefined (Japanese): \"Even a lawless land needs rules. Even anarchy requires order.\" \r\n- Kylian Cyaxan
undefined (Korean): \"법이 미치지 않는 곳에도 규칙은 필요하고, 무정부 상태에도 질서는 필요하지.\" - 킬리안 사이악산
undefined (Portuguese): \"Até uma terra sem lei precisa de regras. Até a anarquia exige ordem.\"\r\n- Kylian Cyaxan
undefined (Russian): «‎Даже в краю беззакония нужны правила. Даже анархия требует порядка»\r\n– Килиан Шиазан
undefined (Spanish): \"Hasta una tierra sin ley necesita normas. Hasta la anarquía requiere orden\". - Kylian Cyaxan
undefined (Thai): \"แผ่นดินไร้กฎยังต้องการกฎหมาย อนาธิปไตยยังต้องการความ\r\nเรียบร้อย\" - ไคเลียน ไซยาซัน
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 「法外之地仍須規則，無法之境亦講究秩序。」- 奇里安．塞亞珊

string_8: As Cyaxan's criminal empire grew, so too did its need for enforcers. The Trarthan militia was its answer.
undefined (French): Plus l'empire criminel de Cyaxan grandissait, plus il avait besoin de faire respecter ses lois. La milice trarthienne était la solution.
undefined (German): Mit der Größe des cyaxanischen kriminellen Imperiums wuchs auch sein Bedarf an Vollstreckern. Die trarthanische Miliz war die Antwort.
undefined (Japanese): As Cyaxan's criminal empire grew, so too did its need for enforcers. The Trarthan militia was its answer.
undefined (Korean): 사이악산의 범죄 제국이 성장할수록, 집행자에 대한 필요도 높아졌다. 그리고 그 해답이 바로 트라투스 민병대였다.
undefined (Portuguese): À medida que o império do crime de Cyaxan crescia, crescia também a necessidade de quem fizesse valer suas vontades. A resposta foi a milícia de Trarthus.
undefined (Russian): По мере роста криминальной империи Шиазана росла нужда и в мордоворотах. Ответом стало ополчение Тератны.
undefined (Spanish): A medida que creció el imperio criminal de Cyaxan, también lo hizo su necesidad de tener ejecutores. La milicia trarthana fue su respuesta.
undefined (Thai): ยามที่จักรวรรดิอาชญากรของไซยาซันเติบโต ความต้องการผู้คุม\r\nก็เติบใหญ่ ทหารอาสาทาร์ทานจึงเป็นคำตอบ
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 隨著塞亞珊的罪惡帝國拓展版圖，維持秩序的人力需求也與日俱增，而特拉特斯民兵就是他們的因應方案。

string_8: Order came later. At first, the Trarthan militia was little more than muscle - sold to the highest house, and drunk on its coin.
undefined (French): L'ordre vint plus tard. Au début, la milice trarthienne était à peine plus que des gros bras : achetée par la plus grande maison, et saoule avec son argent.
undefined (German): Ordnung kam später. Zuerst war die trarthanische Miliz nicht mehr als ein Haufen Schläger - verkauft an das höchste Haus und betrunken auf dessen Kosten.
undefined (Japanese): Order came later. At first, the Trarthan militia was little more than muscle - sold to the highest house, and drunk on its coin.
undefined (Korean): 질서가 찾아온 것은 나중의 일이었다. 본디 트라투스의 민병대는 가장 높은 값을 부르는 가문에 충성하고 그 돈으로 술독에 빠져 사는 폭력배들이나 다름없었다.
undefined (Portuguese): A ordem veio depois. No início, a milícia de Trarthus era apenas uma força bruta vendida à casa que pagasse mais, e nadava em dinheiro.
undefined (Russian): Порядок пришёл позже. Поначалу ополчение Тератны было сборищем громил, сворачивавших шеи по приказу того, кто больше заплатит, и напивавшихся на барыш.
undefined (Spanish): La orden vino después. Al principio, la milicia trarthana era poco más que músculo; se vendía a la mejor casa y bebía de sus monedas.
undefined (Thai): ความเป็นระเบียบตามมาในภายหลัง ภายแรกทหารอาสาทาร์ทาน\r\nเป็นแค่กลุ่มคนมีกำลังที่รับเหรียญจากบ้านที่รวยที่สุดมาเมาหยำเป
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 在以秩序為訴求前，特拉特斯民兵和看錢辦事的打手們並無不同，為出價最高的家族辦事並從中謀利。

string_8: The Trarthan militia delivers justice swiftly - usually before a crime is even committed.
undefined (French): La milice trarthienne rend la justice rapidement. La plupart du temps avant même qu'un crime soit commis.
undefined (German): Die trarthanische Miliz sorgt für schnelle Gerechtigkeit - normalerweise bevor überhaupt ein Verbrechen begangen wurde.
undefined (Japanese): The Trarthan militia delivers justice swiftly - usually before a crime is even committed.
undefined (Korean): 트라투스 민병대는 신속하게, 대개는 범죄가 일어나기도 전에 정의의 심판을 내린다.
undefined (Portuguese): A milícia de Trarthus faz justiça rápido, normalmente antes mesmo de o crime acontecer.
undefined (Russian): Ополчение в Тератне несло правосудие с большой быстротой – обычно ещё до самого преступления.
undefined (Spanish): La milicia trarthana imparte justicia con rapidez, normalmente antes incluso de que se cometa un crimen.
undefined (Thai): ทหารรับจ้างทาร์ทานผดุงความยุติธรรมอย่างเร็วไว\r\nส่วนใหญ่มักเกิดขึ้นก่อนที่จะเกิดอาชญากรรมใดๆ เสียอีก
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 特拉特斯民兵十分具有效率，通常在「罪行」發生前便處理妥當。

string_8: \"The militia don't keep the peace. They keep Trarthus profitable.\"
undefined (French): « La milice ne maintient pas la paix. Elle maintient la rentabilité de Trarthus. »
undefined (German): \"Die Miliz ist nicht dazu da, den Frieden zu bewahren. Sie ist dazu da, den Profit von Trarthus zu bewahren.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"The militia don't keep the peace. They keep Trarthus profitable.\"
undefined (Korean): \"민병대의 목적은 평화를 유지하는 게 아니야. 트라투스에 돈을 벌어다 주는 거지.\"
undefined (Portuguese): \"A milícia não mantém a paz. Mantém o lucro de Trarthus.\"
undefined (Russian): «Ополчение не мир поддерживает. Оно поддерживает Тератну прибыльной».
undefined (Spanish): \"La milicia no mantiene la paz. Mantiene a Trarthus productiva\".
undefined (Thai): \"ทหารอาสาไม่ได้รักษาความสงบ แต่ทำให้ทาร์ทัสทำกำไรต่อไปได้\r\nต่างหาก\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 「民兵們並非維持秩序與和平，而是讓特拉特斯始終有利可圖。」

string_8: \"They weren't just enforcers. They were reminders - of who ruled Korathin's gutters, and what disobedience cost.\"
undefined (French): « Ce ne sont pas que des exécuteurs. Ils sont un rappel, de celui qui dirige les rues de Korathin, et du coût de la désobéissance. »
undefined (German): \"Sie waren nicht nur Vollstrecker. Sie waren da, um uns daran zu erinnern, wer über die Gossen von Korathin herrschte und was der Preis des Ungehorsams war.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"They weren't just enforcers. They were reminders - of who ruled Korathin's gutters, and what disobedience cost.\"
undefined (Korean): \"그들은 단순한 집행자가 아니라 코라틴의 지배자가 누구이며, 불복종의 대가가 무엇인지 일깨워주는 존재였다.\"
undefined (Portuguese): \"Não eram só capangas. Eram o lembrete de quem mandava nos becos de Korathin, e do preço da desobediência.\"
undefined (Russian): «Это были не просто громилы. Это было напоминание – о том, кто правил в канавах Корафина, и о том, чего стоило неповиновение».
undefined (Spanish): \"No eran solo ejecutores. Eran recordatorios de quién gobernaba en las alcantarillas de Korathin y lo que costó esa desobediencia\".
undefined (Thai): \"พวกเขาไม่ได้เป็นเพียงผู้คุมเท่านั้น แต่เป็นเครื่องเตือนใจว่า\r\nใครเป็นใหญ่ในตรอกของโคราธิน และการขัดขืนมีราคาเช่นไร\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 「他們不只維護秩序，更隨時提醒著誰才是科拉廷的主事者，惹上他們會付出什麼樣的代價。」

string_8: For a time, the militia had the slums on lockdown. Then Cyaxan flooded them with gems - and the streets ran red with blood.
undefined (French): Pendant un temps, la milice confina les bas-quartiers. Puis Cyaxan les recouvrit de gemmes, et les rues furent inondées de sang.
undefined (German): Die Miliz schottete die Slums für eine Weile ab. Dann überschütteten die Cyaxan sie mit Gemmen - und die Straßen waren rot vor Blut.
undefined (Japanese): For a time, the militia had the slums on lockdown. Then Cyaxan flooded them with gems - and the streets ran red with blood.
undefined (Korean): 한동안은 민병대가 빈민가를 봉쇄했다. 그러나 사이악산이 그곳에 보석을 뿌려대자, 길거리가 피바다로 변했다.
undefined (Portuguese): Por um tempo, as favelas ficaram sob o controle da milícia. Mas aí Cyaxan as afundou em gemas, e as ruas se tingiram de sangue.
undefined (Russian): Какое-то время ополчение держало трущобы в изоляции. Шиазан наводнил их камнями – и улицы покраснели от крови.
undefined (Spanish): Durante un tiempo, la milicia tenía las barriadas en confinamiento. Entonces, Cyaxan los inundó de gemas, y las calles se tiñeron de sangre.
undefined (Thai): ทหารอาสาคุมสลัมได้พักหนึ่ง แล้วไซยาซันก็มอบมณีมากมาย\r\nให้กับพวกเขา ถนนจึงท่วมไปด้วยเลือด
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 民兵曾讓貧民窟唯命是從，後來塞亞珊家族讓寶石在貧民窟流通……街頭巷尾便濺血事件頻傳。

string_8: Of all Kylian Cyaxan's sins, virtue gems were the most costly. Blinded by greed, he never foresaw the chaos they'd unleash.
undefined (French): De tous les péchés de Kylian Cyaxan, les gemmes de vertu furent les plus préjudiciables. Aveuglé par la cupidité, il ne put prédire le chaos qu'elles déchaîneraient.
undefined (German): Von allen Sünden, die Kylian Cyaxan je beging, hatten die Machtgemmen den höchsten Preis. Von Gier geblendet war er unfähig vorherzusehen, welchen Chaos sie entfesseln würden.
undefined (Japanese): Of all Kylian Cyaxan's sins, virtue gems were the most costly. Blinded by greed, he never foresaw the chaos they'd unleash.
undefined (Korean): 킬리안 사이악산이 저지른 수많은 죄악 중, 가장 값비싼 대가가 뒤따랐던 것은 힘의 마석이었다. 탐욕에 눈이 먼 그는 마석이 불러올 혼란을 끝내 예견하지 못했다.
undefined (Portuguese): De todos os pecados de Kylian Cyaxan, as gemas da virtude foram o mais caro. Cego pela ganância, ele nunca previu o caos que causariam.
undefined (Russian): Из всех грехов Килиана Шиазана камни добродетели обошлись дороже всего. Ослеплённый жадностью, он не предвидел хаоса, который они принесут.
undefined (Spanish): De todos los pecados de Kylian Cyaxan, las gemas de virtud eran el más caro. Cegado por la codicia, nunca previó el caos que liberarían.
undefined (Thai): ในบาปทั้งหลายของไคเลียน ไซยาซัน มณีบารมีนั้นราคาแพงยิ่ง\r\nเมื่อความโลภบังตา เขาจึงไม่เห็นว่าจะเกิดความวุ่นวายได้ถึงเพียงใด
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 奇里安．塞亞珊的諸多惡行裡，古靈寶石是影響最深刻的一個。他受貪婪矇蔽雙眼，未曾設想隨之而來的失序狀態。

string_8: Kylian Cyaxan demanded a swift response to the chaos in the streets. The militia answered - virtue gems in hand.
undefined (French): Kylian Cyaxan demanda une réponse rapide au chaos dans les rues. La milice répondit, gemmes de vertu en main.
undefined (German): Kylian Cyaxan forderte eine schnelle Antwort auf da Chaos in den Straßen. Die Miliz antwortete - mit Machtgemmen in ihren Händen.
undefined (Japanese): Kylian Cyaxan demanded a swift response to the chaos in the streets. The militia answered - virtue gems in hand.
undefined (Korean): 혼란이 길거리를 뒤덮자, 킬리안 사이악산은 신속한 대응을 요구했다. 그러자 힘의 마석을 쥔 민병대가 이에 응했다.
undefined (Portuguese): Kylian Cyaxan exigiu uma resposta imediata ao caos nas ruas. A milícia atendeu, armada com gemas da virtude.
undefined (Russian): Килиан Шиазан потребовал быстрого ответа на творящийся на улицах хаос. Ополчение ответило – с камнями добродетелей в руках.
undefined (Spanish): Kylian Cyaxan exigió una respuesta rápida al caos de las calles. La milicia respondió, con las gemas de virtud en la mano.
undefined (Thai): ไคเลียน ไซยาซันสั่งให้โต้ตอบกับความวุ่นวายบนท้องถนนโดยไว\r\nทหารอาสาตอบรับ... พร้อมกับมณีบารมีในมือ
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 奇里安．塞亞珊要求儘快解決亂象。民兵們同樣以古靈寶石做為回應。

string_8: The militia met fire with fire - gems for gems, blood for blood.
undefined (French): La milice combattit le feu par le feu — gemmes pour gemmes, sang pour sang.
undefined (German): Die Miliz bekämpfte Feuer mit Feuer - Gemmen gegen Gemmen, Blut für Blut.
undefined (Japanese): The militia met fire with fire - gems for gems, blood for blood.
undefined (Korean): 민병대는 불에는 불, 마석에는 마석, 피에는 피로 응수했다.
undefined (Portuguese): A milícia revidou à altura: gema por gema, sangue por sangue.
undefined (Russian): Ополчение встретило огонь огнём – камень за камень, кровь за кровь.
undefined (Spanish): La milicia se enfrentó al fuego con fuego, a las gemas con gemas y a la sangre con sangre.
undefined (Thai): ทหารอาสาเอาไฟมาสู้กับไฟ เอามณีมาประชันกับมณี เอาเลือดมา\r\nล้างเลือด
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 民兵們的作為讓此處血流成河。

string_8: With gems came power - and with power came fewer survivors of the militia's 'justice'.
undefined (French): Avec les gemmes vint le pouvoir, et avec le pouvoir vinrent de moins en moins de survivants de la « justice » de la milice.
undefined (German): Mit den Gemmen wuchs die Macht - und mit der Macht gab es immer weniger Überlebende der 'Rechtsprechung' der Miliz.
undefined (Japanese): With gems came power - and with power came fewer survivors of the militia's 'justice'.
undefined (Korean): 마석은 힘을 가져다주었고, 그 힘은 민병대의 '정의'로부터 살아남는 이들의 수를 줄였다.
undefined (Portuguese): Com as gemas veio o poder, e com o poder, menos sobreviventes da \"justiça\" da milícia.
undefined (Russian): С камнями пришла власть – а с властью стало меньше выживших в результате «правосудия».
undefined (Spanish): Con las gemas llegó el poder; y con el poder, llegaron menos supervivientes de la \"justicia\" de la milicia.
undefined (Thai): มณีก่อให้เกิดพลัง พลังก่อให้เกิด 'ความยุติธรรม' ของทหารอาสา\r\nที่ก่อให้เกิดผู้รอดชีวิตน้อยลง
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 古靈寶石帶來力量，也讓民兵們更肆無忌憚地取人性命。

string_8: \"They called it peace when the killing slowed. Not justice - just fewer people left to fight back... and even fewer who would dare.\"
undefined (French): Ils ont appelé cela « paix » quand les massacres avaient ralenti. Ce n'était pas de la justice, il y avait juste moins de gens pour se défendre… et encore moins de gens qui oseraient se défendre.
undefined (German): \"Sie nannten es Frieden, als das Töten nachließ. Keine Gerechtigkeit - es waren nur weniger Leute übrig, die sich noch wehren konnten ... und noch weniger, die es wagten.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"They called it peace when the killing slowed. Not justice - just fewer people left to fight back... and even fewer who would dare.\"
undefined (Korean): 살육이 잦아들자 사람들은 이를 평화라고 불렀지만, 정의는 아니었다. 그저 맞서 싸울 수 있는 사람이 줄었고, 그럴 용기가 있는 사람은 더더욱 줄어든 것일 뿐.
undefined (Portuguese): \"Chamaram de paz quando a matança deu uma trégua. Mas não era justiça, só restavam menos pessoas para lutar... e ainda menos para se atrever a isso.\"
undefined (Russian): «‎Миром назвали замедление убийств. Не правосудие – просто меньше осталось людей, способных отбиваться... и ещё меньше тех, кто рискнёт».
undefined (Spanish): \"Lo llamaron paz cuando se ralentizaron las muertes. No justicia, solo es que quedaba menos gente que pudiera resistir... e incluso menos que se atrevieran\".
undefined (Thai): \"เมื่อการเข่นฆ่าซาลง พวกเขาเรียกว่าเป็นความสงบ ไม่ใช่ความ\r\nยุติธรรม เพียงแต่มีคนน้อยลง... และมีคนกล้าขัดขืนน้อยกว่านั้น\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 當這樣的殺戮不再屍橫遍野，代表活口已所剩無幾，其中膽敢造次的人更是屈指可數。

string_8: {0} Cyaxan once kept order in Korathin's worst quarter. Now she keeps trophies instead.
undefined (French): Elle maintenait autrefois l'ordre dans le pire quartier de Korathin. Elle collectionne désormais des trophées.
undefined (German): Einst hielt {0} Cyaxan in den schlimmsten Vierteln von Korathin die Ordnung aufrecht. Stattdessen sammelt sie jetzt Trophäen.
undefined (Japanese): {0} Cyaxan once kept order in Korathin's worst quarter. Now she keeps trophies instead.
undefined (Korean): 한때 코라틴 최악의 구역에서 질서를 유지하던 그녀는 이제 전리품을 수집한다.
undefined (Portuguese): {0} Cyaxan já botou ordem no pior bairro de Korathin. Hoje, coleciona troféus dos que cruzam seu caminho.
undefined (Russian): Когда-то держала в руках порядок в худшем квартале Корафина. Теперь держит трофеи.

undefined (Thai): {0} ไซยาซันเคยคุมระเบียบในตรอกที่แย่ที่สุดในโคราธิน\r\nบัดนี้เธอเก็บทรัพย์สมบัติแทน
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 她當初維持科拉廷的秩序，現在則是毫無忌憚地搜刮民脂民膏。

string_8: {0} was born of Cyaxan stock, raised on slum smoke and discipline.
undefined (French): Née de la lignée de Cyaxan, élevée dans la discipline et la fumée des bas-quartiers.
undefined (German): {0} wurde in das Haus Cyaxan geboren, aufgewachsen mit dem Rauch der Slums und Disziplin.
undefined (Japanese): {0} was born of Cyaxan stock, raised on slum smoke and discipline.
undefined (Korean): 사이악산 가문의 노예로 태어나, 빈민가의 매연과 규율 속에서 자라났다.
undefined (Portuguese): {0}, cyaxana de sangue, criada entre fumaça de favela e disciplina.

undefined (Spanish): {0} nació en el linaje de Cyaxan, y se crió con el humo y la disciplina de las barriadas.
undefined (Thai): {0} เกิด​ใน​สกุล​ขุนนาง​ไซยาซัน โต​มา​กับ​ควัน​สลัม​และ​ระเบียบ​วินัย
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 出身塞亞珊家族，自幼便目睹貧民窟的紛亂，但謹遵紀律的教誨。

undefined (Spanish): Trarthus era árido tras el Cataclismo vaal... hasta que el Imperio empezó a exiliar a sus indeseados a sus lúgubres costas.
undefined (Thai): \"ทาร์ทัสรกร้างหลังจากวันมหาภัยพิบัติ... จนกระทั่งจักรวรรดิเริ่ม\r\nขับไล่ผู้ที่ไม่ถึงประสงค์ไปยังชายฝั่งหนาวเหน็บเช่นนี้
undefined (Traditional Chinese): Trarthus was barren after the Vaal Cataclysm... until the Empire began exiling their unwanted to its bleak shores.

undefined (German): \"Unsere Vorfahren wurden verbannt, damit das Ewige Kaiserreich seinen Tausendjährigen Frieden haben konnte. Wraeclast ist mir scheißegal.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"Our ancestors were exiled so that the Eternal Empire could have its thousand-year peace. I don't give a damn about Wraeclast.\"
undefined (Korean): \"우리의 선조들은 영원한 제국이 천년성대를 누릴 수 있도록 유배되었지. 레이클라스트 같은 건 어찌 되든 내 알 바 아니다.\"

undefined (Spanish): \"Nuestros ancestros fueron exiliados para que el Imperio eterno pudiera tener sus mil años de paz. Me importa un pimiento Wraeclast\".
undefined (Thai): \"บรรพชนของเราถูกเนรเทศเพื่อให้จักรวรรดินิรันดร์ได้มีสันติมาพันปี\r\nข้าไม่สนใจไยดีอะไรกับเวร์แคลส์ทดอก\"

undefined (Portuguese): As gemas de Trarthus têm um estilo próprio: são brutais, como o povo de lá.

string_8: Cyaxan brothels bore no name. But those who entered often forget their own.

undefined (Traditional Chinese): 塞亞珊家族的風俗場所以無名著稱，而光顧的雅客們往往會忘卻自己的一切。

undefined (Japanese): First came desire. Then came dependency. Cyaxan offered both - by design.

undefined (Traditional Chinese): 塞亞珊家族的眾花魁是灌迷湯的箇中好手。在歡愉時分灑下的迷藥讓來客們難抵再次造訪的渴望，陷入其中而無法自拔。

string_8: Most were addicted before they even knew it - such was the potency of Cyaxan's blend.

undefined (Traditional Chinese): 塞亞珊家族將這門吸血的生意經營得淋漓盡致。

string_8: \"In the early days, the drug trade was shared. Then Cyaxan made sharing... unprofitable.\"

undefined (Portuguese): \"No início, o tráfico era repartido. Foi assim até Cyaxan tornar isso... não lucrativo.\"

undefined (Traditional Chinese): 「藥頭這門生意原本眾人能分一杯羹，後來塞亞珊家族……連一口湯都不分。」

undefined (Japanese): When even dependency began to dull, Kylian Cyaxan sought something stronger - 'virtue' in crystalline form.
undefined (Korean): 의존성조차 무뎌지자, 킬리안 사이악산은 더 강한 걸 찾았다. 그것이 바로 '힘' 그 자체의 결정체였다.
undefined (Portuguese): Quando o vício já não bastava, Kylian Cyaxan foi atrás de algo mais forte: a tal da \"virtude\" em forma de cristal.

undefined (Traditional Chinese): 金山銀山總有枯竭的一天，奇里安．塞亞珊便將腦筋動到了「古靈寶石」上。

string_8: While most wielded gems for violence, Kylian Cyaxan saw in them something far more sordid.
undefined (French): La plupart des gens utilisaient les gemmes de façon violente, Kylian Cyaxan vit en elles quelque chose de bien plus sordide.
undefined (German): Während die meisten die Gemmen für ihre Gewalttaten einsetzten, sah Kylian Cyaxan in ihnen etwas viel Abscheulicheres\"
undefined (Japanese): While most wielded gems for violence, Kylian Cyaxan saw in them something far more sordid.
undefined (Korean): 대부분은 마석을 폭력적인 곳에 썼지만, 사이악산은 그 안에서 훨씬 더 추악한 잠재력을 엿봤다.
undefined (Portuguese): Enquanto muitos usavam as gemas como armas, Kylian Cyaxan enxergou algo bem mais perverso nelas.

undefined (Thai): แม้คนส่วนใหญ่ใช้มณีในการก่อความรุนแรง แต่ไซยาซันกลับแลเห็น\r\nสิ่งที่เสื่อมทรามกว่านั้นนัก
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 大多數的古靈寶石用作爭戰的工具，奇里安．塞亞珊則是挑戰人性的底限。

string_8: The first gem-lit flesh in Trarthus didn't belong to a warrior. It belonged to a courtesan.
undefined (French): La première chair sertie de gemmes à Trarthus n'appartenait pas à un guerrier. Elle appartenait à une courtisane.
undefined (German): Der erste gemmengeschmückte Körper in Trarthus gehörte nicht einem Krieger. Er gehörte einer Kurtisane.
undefined (Japanese): The first gem-lit flesh in Trarthus didn't belong to a warrior. It belonged to a courtesan.
undefined (Korean): 트라투스에서 처음으로 살점에 마석의 빛을 두른 것은 전사가 아닌 매춘부였다.
undefined (Portuguese): Não foi um guerreiro quem brilhou com uma gema no corpo pela primeira vez em Trarthus. Foi uma cortesã.

undefined (Spanish): La primera carne iluminada por las gemas de Trarthus no pertenecía a un guerrero. Pertenecía a un cortesano.
undefined (Thai): ผู้มีกายเนื้อแผ่แสงมณีคนแรกในทาร์ทัสหาใช่นักรบไม่ แต่เป็นโสเภณี\r\nต่างหาก
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 在特拉特斯，第一顆古靈寶石不屬於戰士，而是用於一位花魁。

string_8: Some gems enhanced sensation. Others suppressed it - turning bodies into tools of compliance.
undefined (French): Certaines gemmes augmentaient la sensation. D'autres l'éliminaient, transformant les corps en outils de soumission.
undefined (German): Einige Gemmen verstärkten Empfindungen. Andere unterdrückten sie - und verwandelten Körper in willfährige Werkzeuge.
undefined (Japanese): Some gems enhanced sensation. Others suppressed it - turning bodies into tools of compliance.
undefined (Korean): 어떤 마석은 감각을 극대화하고 어떤 마석은 감각을 억제하여, 육신을 복종의 도구로 바꿔 놓았다.
undefined (Portuguese): Algumas gemas despertavam os sentidos. Outras entorpeciam, e o corpo só obedecia.
undefined (Russian): Некоторые камни усиливали ощущения. Другие подавляли их – превращая тела в податливый инструмент.
undefined (Spanish): Algunas gemas aumentaban las sensaciones. Otras las suprimían para convertir los cuerpos en herramientas de docilidad.
undefined (Thai): มณีบางเม็ดเสริมความรู้สึก บางเม็ดก็ปิดกั้นความรู้สึก\r\nทำให้ร่างกายกลายเป็นเครื่องมือแห่งการยินยอม
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 其中一些寶石會增強身體的感覺，也有一些寶石會抑制這些感覺，進而使得人的軀體成為任憑擺布的工具。

string_8: What began as pleasure became ritual. What began as choice became conditioning.
undefined (French): Ce qui était au départ un plaisir devint un rituel. Ce qui était au départ un choix devint un conditionnement.

undefined (Russian): В лучшие годы Киита построили больше чем города – они построили себе преимущество. На то время ни один Дом не смел оспорить их контроль над Тератной.
undefined (Spanish): En su apogeo, Keita construyó más que ciudades, construyeron influencia. Durante un tiempo, ninguna otra casa se atrevió a intentar arrebatarles su control sobre Trarthus.
undefined (Thai): ในยามที่สกุลเคย์ทารุ่งเรือง พวกเขาสร้างทั้งเมืองและอำนาจ\r\nจึงไม่มีบ้านใดกล้าท้าทายความเป็นใหญ่ในทาร์ทัสอยู่ช่วงหนึ่ง
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 在凱塔家族鼎盛之時，他們不僅主持城市建構工作，更是權柄在手。當時的特拉特斯並無家族膽敢與他們分庭抗禮。

string_8: Ixan Keita helped build Trarthus - and nearly ruled it. But power begets ambition, and ambition always demands more.
undefined (French): Ixan Keita a aidé à bâtir Trarthus, et a failli la diriger. Mais le pouvoir engendre l'ambition, et l'ambition en demande toujours plus.
undefined (German): Ixan Keita half dabei, Trathus zu erbauen - und hätte es beinahe beherrscht. Aber aus Macht entsteht Ehrgeiz und Ehrgeiz verlangt immer nach mehr.
undefined (Japanese): Ixan Keita helped build Trarthus - and nearly ruled it. But power begets ambition, and ambition always demands more.
undefined (Korean): 익산 케이타는 트라투스를 건설하는 데 이바지했고, 그곳의 통치자로 군림할 뻔도 했다. 그러나 권력은 더 큰 야망을 부르고, 야망은 항상 더 많은 것을 요구한다.
undefined (Portuguese): Ixan Keita ajudou a erguer Trarthus, e quase virou seu dono. Mas poder traz ambição, e ambição nunca se dá por satisfeita.
undefined (Russian): Иксан Киита помог построить Тератну – и практически правил ей. Но власть порождает амбиции, а амбиции всегда требуют большего.
undefined (Spanish): Ixan Keita ayudó a construir Trarthus, y casi la gobernó. Pero el poder genera ambición, y la ambición siempre exige más.
undefined (Thai): อิกซาน เคย์ทาช่วยสร้างทาร์ทัสขึ้นมา และเกือบได้ปกครองเมือง\r\nแต่พลังนำพาความทะเยอทะยาน ที่ต้องการอะไรมากกว่านั้นเสมอ
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 伊珊．凱塔協助建立特拉特斯……而他距離統治只有一步之遙。然而，權力總會伴隨野心，而野心會索求更多。

string_8: The ambition of Ixan Keita was his undoing. His bid for power sparked war with Bardiya - a war Keita could not win.
undefined (French): L'ambition d'Ixan Keita fut sa perte. Sa tentative de prise de pouvoir fit éclater une guerre contre Bardiya, une guerre que Keita ne pouvait gagner.
undefined (German): Der Ehrgeiz von Ixan Keita war sein Untergang. Sein Anspruch auf die Macht löste einen Krieg mit den Bardiya aus - ein Krieg, den Keita nicht gewinnen konnte.
undefined (Japanese): The ambition of Ixan Keita was his undoing. His bid for power sparked war with Bardiya - a war Keita could not win.
undefined (Korean): 익산 케이타의 야망은 그의 파멸을 불렀다. 그는 권력을 잡기 위해 바르디야와 전쟁을 일으켰으나, 이는 케이타가 승리할 수 없는 싸움이었다.
undefined (Portuguese): A ambição de Ixan Keita foi sua ruína. Ele quis mais do que podia e forçou uma guerra que não tinha como vencer contra Bardiya.
undefined (Russian): Амбиции Иксана Кииты его и сгубили. Его жажда власти разожгла войну с Бардией – войну, которую Киита не мог выиграть.
undefined (Spanish): La ambición de Ixan Keita fue su final. Su lucha por el poder desató la guerra con Bardiya, una guerra que Keita no podía ganar.
undefined (Thai): อิกซาน เคย์ทาพ่ายด้วยฤทธิ์ความทะเยอทะยานตน การแสวงอำนาจ\r\nของเขาจุดไฟสงครามกับบ้านบาร์ดิยา สงครามที่เคย์ทามิอาจชนะ
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 伊珊．凱塔的野心最終讓他失勢。渴求力量的他發起對巴迪亞家族的戰爭，他毫無勝算。

string_8: Keita held the chains. Bardiya cut the purse strings. Trarthus watched as labour lost to leverage - and coin won the war.
undefined (French): Keita tenait les chaînes. Bardiya coupait les fils des bourses. Trarthus vit le labeur perdre contre l'influence, et l'argent gagna la guerre.
undefined (German): Keita hielt die Ketten in der Hand. Bardiya schnitt den Geldfluss ab. Trarthus sah zu, wie Arbeit gegen Einfluss verlor - und das Geld gewann den Krieg.
undefined (Japanese): Keita held the chains. Bardiya cut the purse strings. Trarthus watched as labour lost to leverage - and coin won the war.
undefined (Korean): 케이타 가문에는 노예가 있었지만, 바르디야 가문은 돈줄을 끊었다. 트라투스는 노동력이 영향력 앞에 무너지고, 돈이 전쟁의 승패를 가르는 것을 지켜보았다.
undefined (Portuguese): Keita tinha os escravos. Bardiya, o dinheiro. Trarthus viu a força se transformar em dívida e o ouro ganhar a guerra.
undefined (Russian): Киита держал цепи. Бардия резал ленты кошельков. Тератна наблюдала, как труд проиграл золоту – и деньги выиграли войну.
undefined (Spanish): Keita sostenía las cadenas. Bardiya quitaba el apoyo financiero. Trarthus observó cómo la mano de obra perdía ante la influencia, y las monedas ganaron la guerra.
undefined (Thai): เคย์ทากุมโซ่ บาร์ดิยาตัดสายกระเป๋า ทาร์ทัสเฝ้ามองในยามที่แรงงาน\r\nพ่ายแพ้แก่อำนาจ... และเหรียญชนะสงคราม
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 凱塔家族操縱這群奴隸，而巴迪亞家族斬斷了金援。特拉特斯其他勢力則見證了金錢才是力量的泉源。

string_8: Keita swore fealty to the Council with a clenched jaw. Better a seat at the table than exile from the game entirely.
undefined (French): Keita jura fidélité au Conseil en serrant les dents. Une place autour de la table valait mieux qu'un exil total du jeu.
undefined (German): Keita schwor mit zusammengebissenen Zähnen dem Rat die Treue. Lieber ein Stuhl am Tisch, als vollständig aus dem Spiel verbannt zu werden.
undefined (Japanese): Keita swore fealty to the Council with a clenched jaw. Better a seat at the table than exile from the game entirely.
undefined (Korean): 케이타는 이를 악문 채 의회에 충성을 맹세했다. 권력 투쟁에서 완전히 밀려나느니, 한 자리라도 차지하는 편이 나았기에.
undefined (Portuguese): Com raiva estampada na cara, Keita jurou lealdade ao conselho. Antes um lugar à mesa a ser excluída do jogo.
undefined (Russian): Стиснув зубы, Киита поклялся в верности Совету. Лучше сохранить за собой место у стола, чем насовсем выбыть из игры.
undefined (Spanish): Keita juró lealtad al consejo con la mandíbula apretada. Era mejor tener un asiento en la mesa que estar exiliado totalmente del juego.
undefined (Thai): บ้านเคย์ทาสาบานตนต่อสภาพร้อมกับกัดฟัน มีที่นั่งบนโต๊ะเสียยัง\r\nดีกว่าถูกขับไล่ออกจากเกมโดยถาวร
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 凱塔家族不得不委曲求全向商會低頭。比起做個喪家犬，還不如把餅分出來大家一起吃。

string_8: Though the Keita of today is still a House of influence, Bardiya remembers their treachery - and limits their power accordingly.
undefined (French): Bien que Keita soit aujourd'hui toujours une maison influente, Bardiya n'a pas oublié sa traîtrise et limite son pouvoir en conséquence.
undefined (German): Auch wenn die Keita heute immer noch ein Haus mit Einfluss sind, erinnern sich die Bardiya an ihre Heimtücke - und beschneiden entsprechend ihre Macht.
undefined (Japanese): Though the Keita of today is still a House of influence, Bardiya remembers their treachery - and limits their power accordingly.
undefined (Korean): 오늘날에도 케이타는 유력한 가문 중 하나다. 그러나 바르디야 가문은 아직도 그들의 배신을 기억하고 있기에, 케이타 가문의 권력을 제한하고 있다.
undefined (Portuguese): Hoje, a casa Keita ainda tem influência, mas Bardiya não esqueceu a traição e mantém o poder deles na rédea curta.
undefined (Russian): Хотя Киита сегодня по-прежнему влиятельный Дом, Бардия помнят об их предательстве – и соответственно ограничивают их власть.
undefined (Spanish): Aunque la Keita de hoy sigue siendo una Casa con influencia, Bardiya recuerda su traición y limita su poder en consecuencia.
undefined (Thai): แม้ว่าบ้านเคย์ทายังเป็นบ้านที่มีอิทธิพลนัก แต่บ้านบาร์ดิยาจดจำ\r\nการหักหลังของบ้านนี้ แล้วจำกัดพลังของเขาตามโอกาส
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 凱塔家族仍舊具有相當的影響力，但巴迪亞家族深知他們時不時就想動歪腦筋，因此限制了他們的權利。

string_8: \"House Keita wrote the bloody book on cruelty. Think of the worst bastard you know - either they're a Keitan, or a poor imitation.\"
undefined (French): « La maison Keita est une experte de la cruauté. Pensez au pire salaud que vous connaissez. Il s'agit soit d'un Keitien, soit d'une mauvaise imitation. »
undefined (German): \"Haus Keita sind blutgetränkte Experten in Sachen Grausamkeit. Stellt Euch den schlimmsten Bastard vor, den Ihr kennt - sie sind entweder Keita oder eine armselige Imitation.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"House Keita wrote the bloody book on cruelty. Think of the worst bastard you know - either they're a Keitan, or a poor imitation.\"
undefined (Korean): \"케이타 가문은 잔혹 행위에 대해 책까지 써 냈어. 네가 아는 최악의 인간을 떠올려 봐. 케이타 가문 녀석이 아니라면, 놈들을 어설프게 흉내 내는 놈일걸.\"
undefined (Portuguese): \"A crueldade tem sobrenome: Keita. Pensa no pior canalha que você conhece... Ou é keitano, ou queria ser um.\"
undefined (Russian): «Киита собаку съели на жестокости. Вспомни худшего мерзавца, которого знаешь – либо он из дома Киита, либо жалкое подобие».
undefined (Spanish): \"La Casa Keita escribió el maldito libro de la crueldad. Piensa en el peor bastardo que conozcas; o es un Keita, o una pobre imitación\".
undefined (Thai): \"บ้านเคย์ทาเขียนตำราความอำมหิตมากับมือ นึกถึงโคตรสารเลวใน\r\nชีวิตเจ้าสิ อาจเป็นชาวเคย์ทา หรือคนที่เลียนแบบได้ไม่ดีก็เป็นได้\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 「凱塔家族是殘酷的代言者。當你想到十惡不赦的傢伙，他們若不是和凱塔家族有關係，就是和他們一個模樣。」

string_8: \"The Merchant Council's a leash on House Keita - and the irony ain't lost on 'em. Still, better leashed than buried.\"
undefined (French): « Le Conseil des marchands tient en laisse la maison Keita, et ils n'en ont pas perdu leur ironie. Mais il vaut mieux être tenu en laisse qu'enterré. »
undefined (German): \"Der Rat der Händler hält das Haus Keita an der Leine - und sie verstehen die Ironie. Trotzdem, besser gefesselt als begraben.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"The Merchant Council's a leash on House Keita - and the irony ain't lost on 'em. Still, better leashed than buried.\"
undefined (Korean): \"상인 의회는 케이타 가문에 씌워진 목줄이지. 케이타도 그걸 잘 알아. 그래도 땅에 묻히는 것보다는 목줄에 묶이는 게 낫지.\"
undefined (Portuguese): \"O conselho dos comerciantes mantém Keita na coleira, e eles entendem a ironia. Ainda assim, é melhor estar preso do que morto.\"
undefined (Russian): «Торговый Совет – это поводок на шее Дома Киита, и они тоже видят в этом иронию. Но лучше на поводке, чем в земле».
undefined (Spanish): \"El Consejo de mercaderes es una correa para la Casa Keita. Y la ironía no pasa desapercibida. Aun así, mejor atado en corto que enterrado\".
undefined (Thai): \"สภาพพ่อค้าเป็นเชือกที่ล่ามบ้านเคย์ทาเอาไว้ พวกเขาก็รู้อยู่แก่ใจดี\r\nแต่โดนล่ามไว้เสียยังดีกว่าโดนฝังดิน\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 「商會是凱塔家族的拘束……更是對於他們貪婪和野心的諷刺，但留得青山在，不怕沒柴燒。」

string_8: \"Pain is the language of obedience.\"\r\n - Ixan Keita
undefined (French): « La souffrance est le langage de l'obéissance. » — Ixan Keita
undefined (German): \"Schmerz ist die Sprache des Gehorsams\" \r\n– Ixan Keita
undefined (Japanese): \"Pain is the language of obedience.\"\r\n - Ixan Keita
undefined (Korean): \"고통은 복종의 언어다.\" - 익산 케이타

undefined (Russian): «Боль – это язык подчинения»\r\n– Иксан Киита
undefined (Spanish): \"El dolor es el lenguaje de la obediencia\".\r\n- Ixan Keita
undefined (Thai): \"ความเจ็บปวดเป็นภาษาของความเชื่อง\"\r\n- อิกซาน เคย์ทา
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 「疼痛訴說著遵從。」 - 伊珊．凱塔

undefined (Traditional Chinese): 奴隸對他言聽計從，對手無不橫死街頭，其餘人則了解到應該明哲保身。

string_8: The pits made killers of men... and monsters of those who ran them.
undefined (French): Le Conseil n'a pas vu de place pour lui dans la nouvelle Trarthus. Wraeclast regrettera de lui en avoir donné une.
undefined (German): Die Gruben haben Mörder aus den Menschen gemacht ... und Monster aus denen, die sie anführten.
undefined (Japanese): The pits made killers of men... and monsters of those who ran them.
undefined (Korean): 의회는 새로운 트라투스에 그가 있을 자리는 없다고 여겼다. 레이클라스트는 그에게 자리를 내준 것을 후회하게 될 것이다.
undefined (Portuguese): As rinhas transformavam homens em assassinos... e os que mandavam nelas em monstros.
undefined (Russian): Совет не видел для него места в новой Тератне. Рэкласт пожалеет, что дал ему таковое.
undefined (Spanish): Los fosos convertían a los hombres en asesinos... y a aquellos que los dirigían, en monstruos.
undefined (Thai): สภาไม่มีที่อยู่ให้กับเขาในทาร์ทัสยุคใหม่... เวร์แคลส์ทย่อมเสียใจที่ให้\r\nที่อยู่กับเขาเป็นแน่
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 商會認為他在特拉特斯的新時代並無容身之處，他會為瓦爾克拉斯帶來什麼樣的苦難？

string_8: For centuries, ash from Karui volcanoes rode the wind to Trarthus. It turned slaves into the continent's finest tools.
undefined (French): « Les volcans karuis… ont porté les cendres jusqu'à nous, via le vent, pendant des siècles. Les esclaves travaillent plus efficacement à Trarthus que n'importe où dans le monde. »
undefined (German): Karuische Vulkane … Jahrhundertelang wurde ihre Asche mit dem Wind zu uns getragen. Die Sklaven auf Trarthus betreiben Ackerbau viel effizienter als irgendwo sonst auf der Welt.
undefined (Japanese): For centuries, ash from Karui volcanoes rode the wind to Trarthus. It turned slaves into the continent's finest tools.
undefined (Korean): \"수백 년 동안 카루이의 화산에서 나온 재가 바람에 실려 트라투스로 날아왔어... 덕분에 트라투스의 노예들은 이 세상 그 어디보다도 효율적으로 농사를 짓지.\"
undefined (Portuguese): Por séculos, os ventos levaram as cinzas dos vulcões karui até Trarthus. Transformou os escravos nas melhores ferramentas do continente.
undefined (Russian): Веками пепел от вулканов каруи нёсся по ветру в Тератну. Он превратил рабов в лучший инструмент континента.
undefined (Spanish): Durante siglos, la ceniza de los volcanes karui se dirigió con el viento hasta Trarthus. Convirtió a los esclavos en las mejores herramientas del continente.
undefined (Thai): ภูเขาไฟคารุย... ส่งเถ้าถ่านมาให้เราไปตามลมมาหลายศตวรรษ\r\nทำให้ทาสเป็นเครื่องมือที่เลอค่าที่สุดของทวีปนี้
undefined (Traditional Chinese): For centuries, ash from Karui volcanoes rode the wind to Trarthus. It turned slaves into the continent's finest tools.

string_8: \"Slavery began on Trarthus when a simple farmer offered to serve and grow food in exchange for his life. Pathetic... but profitable.\"
undefined (French): « L'esclavage a commencé à Trarthus quand un simple fermier a proposé de servir et de cultiver de la nourriture en échange de sa vie. Pathétique… mais profitable. »
undefined (German): \"Die Sklaverei auf Trarthus begann, als ein einfacher Bauer seine Dienste und seine Feldfrüchte im Tausch für sein Leben bot. Erbärmlich … aber profitabel.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"Slavery began on Trarthus when a simple farmer offered to serve and grow food in exchange for his life. Pathetic... but profitable.\"
undefined (Korean): \"트라투스의 노예제는 평범한 농부로부터 시작했어. 그는 살려달라며 충성을 맹세하고 먹을 것을 길러 바치겠다고 했지. 한심하기는... 그래도 돈벌이는 짭짤했지.\"
undefined (Portuguese): \"A escravidão começou em Trarthus quando um simples fazendeiro ofereceu sua vida por um campo para cultivar. Patético... mas lucrativo.\"
undefined (Russian): «Рабство в Тератне возникло, когда простой фермер предложил служить и выращивать еду в обмен на свою жизнь. Позорно... но доходно».
undefined (Spanish): \"La esclavitud comenzó en Trarthus cuando un sencillo granjero se ofreció a servir y a cultivar comida a cambio de su vida. Patético... pero rentable\".
undefined (Thai): \"การเลี้ยงทาสเริ่มขึ้นในทาร์ทัสเมื่อชาวไร่คนหนึ่งเสนอตัวว่าจะรับใช้\r\nและปลูกอาหารแลกกับการไว้ชีวิต น่าสมเพช... แต่ให้กำไรดี\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): \"Slavery began on Trarthus when a simple farmer offered to serve and grow food in exchange for his life. Pathetic... but profitable.\"

string_8: Thaumaturgy in Trarthus is like smoke in the lungs - unpleasant, expected, and always present.
undefined (French): La thaumaturgie à Trarthus est comme de la fumée dans les poumons : désagréable, attendue, et toujours présente.
undefined (German): Thaumaturgie ist in Trarthus wie Rauch in den Lungen - unangenehm, zu erwarten und immer präsent.
undefined (Japanese): Thaumaturgy in Trarthus is like smoke in the lungs - unpleasant, expected, and always present.
undefined (Korean): 트라투스의 마석학은 폐 속의 연기와도 같이 거북하고, 피할 수 없으며, 언제나 존재한다.
undefined (Portuguese): Em Trarthus, a taumaturgia é igual à fumaça: incômoda, comum e impossível de evitar.
undefined (Russian): Thaumaturgy in Trarthus is like smoke in the lungs - unpleasant, expected, and always present.
undefined (Spanish): La taumaturgia en Trarthus es como el humo en los pulmones. Desagradable, esperado y siempre presente.
undefined (Thai): มนต์มณีในทาร์ทัสก็ไม่ต่างอะไรกับควันในปอด ไม่น่าอภิรมย์ เป็น\r\nอย่างที่คาด และปรากฏอยู่เสมอ
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 奇術在特拉特斯就像吸入肺中的煙塵，你無時無刻能感受到它造成的不適，卻也揮之不去。

string_8: Before vice, before gems, before brothels and powder - Cyaxan dealt in spices, cloth and coin.
undefined (French): Avant le vice, avant les gemmes, avant les bordels et la poudre, Cyaxan faisait du commerce d'épices, de tissus, et d'argent.
undefined (German): Vor dem Laster, vor den Gemmen, vor den Bordellen und dem Pulver - handelten die Cyaxan mit Gewürzen und Stoffen und verliehen Geld.
undefined (Japanese): Before vice, before gems, before brothels and powder - Cyaxan dealt in spices, cloth and coin.
undefined (Korean): 악에 물들기 전... 마석도, 사창가도, 마약도 없던 시절에 사이악산은 향신료와 천, 그리고 동전을 거래했다.
undefined (Portuguese): Antes do vício, das gemas, dos prostíbulos e do pó, Cyaxan negociava especiarias, tecidos e moedas.
undefined (Russian): Before vice, before gems, before brothels and powder - Cyaxan dealt in spices, cloth and coin.
undefined (Spanish): Antes del vicio, antes de las gemas, antes de los burdeles y las sustancias, Cyaxan comerciaba con especias, telas y monedas.
undefined (Thai): ก่อนมีอบายมุข ก่อนมีมณี ก่อนมีซ่องและผง บ้านไซยาซันค้า\r\nเครื่องเทศ ผ้า และเหรียญ
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 塞亞珊家族原倚賴辛香料、絲綢和資產為生，後來卻涉足罪惡、風俗行業和迷藥。

string_8: \"They all started legitimate - even Cyaxan. But virtue doesn't buy power. Vice does.\"
undefined (French): « Tout le monde a commencé de façon légitime, même Cyaxan. Mais la vertu n'achète pas le pouvoir. Le vice, oui. »
undefined (German): \"Sie alle begannen rechtschaffen - selbst Cyaxan. Aber mit Tugendhaftigkeit kann man keine Macht erkaufen. Mit dem Laster schon.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"They all started legitimate - even Cyaxan. But virtue doesn't buy power. Vice does.\"
undefined (Korean): \"그들은 모두 합법적인 사업으로 시작했지. 심지어는 사이악산도 말이야. 하지만 권력을 가져다주는 건 미덕이 아니라 악덕이야.\"
undefined (Portuguese): \"Todo mundo começou no caminho certo, até Cyaxan. Mas poder não se compra com virtude. É com vício.\"
undefined (Russian): \"They all started legitimate - even Cyaxan. But virtue doesn't buy power. Vice does.\"
undefined (Spanish): \"Todos comenzaron de forma legítima, incluso Cyaxan. Pero la virtud no compra el poder. El vicio sí\".
undefined (Thai): \"ทุกบ้านเริ่มกันอย่างถูกกฎหมาย กระทั่งบ้านไซยาซันก็ตาม แต่\r\nความดีซื้ออำนาจไม่ได้ดอก อบายมุขต่างหากที่ซื้อได้\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 「所有人、包括塞亞珊家族，都從正當事業幹起。然而，互相尊重無法帶來權力，勾心鬥角卻能。」

string_8: Cyaxan didn't need blades. They had margins - and the power that comes from knowing what everyone else wanted.
undefined (French): Cyaxan n'avait pas besoin de lames. Ils avaient des marges et le pouvoir que confère le fait de savoir ce que tout le monde veut.
undefined (German): Die Cyaxan brauchten keine Klingen. Sie hatten Gewinnspannen - und die Macht, die aus dem Wissen erwächst, was alle anderen begehrten.
undefined (Japanese): Cyaxan didn't need blades. They had margins - and the power that comes from knowing what everyone else wanted.
undefined (Korean): 사이악산 가문에는 칼날이 필요 없었다. 그들에게는 이윤, 그리고 타인의 욕망을 읽는 능력에서 오는 힘이 있었다.
undefined (Portuguese): Cyaxan não lutava com armas, mas com benefícios... e a capacidade de entender os desejos dos outros.
undefined (Russian): Cyaxan didn't need blades. They had margins - and the power that comes from knowing what everyone else wanted.
undefined (Spanish): Cyaxan no necesitaba espadas. Tenían márgenes, y el poder que viene de saber qué quieren todos los demás.
undefined (Thai): \"บ้านไซยาซันไม่ต้องการอาวุธ พวกเขามีกำไร และพลังที่มาจากการรู้\r\nว่าคนอื่นๆ ต้องการอะไร\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 塞亞珊家族無須付諸武力。他們坐擁利潤……也了解其他人所追求的事物。

string_8: In time, margins thinned. Rivals grew bolder. So Cyaxan found new markets - darker ones.
undefined (French): Au fil du temps, les marges se sont réduites. Les rivaux sont devenus plus audacieux. Cyaxan a alors trouvé de nouveaux marchés, plus sombres.
undefined (German): Mit der Zeit wurden die Gewinne kleiner. Rivalen wurden mutiger. Also fanden die Cyaxan neue Märkte - finsterere.
undefined (Japanese): In time, margins thinned. Rivals grew bolder. So Cyaxan found new markets - darker ones.
undefined (Korean): 시간이 지나며 이윤은 줄고, 경쟁자들은 점점 대담해지기 시작했다. 이에 사이악산 가문은 더 어두운 시장을 찾아냈다.
undefined (Portuguese): Com os benefícios encolhendo e os rivais ganhando coragem, Cyaxan entrou em mercados mais sombrios.
undefined (Russian): In time, margins thinned. Rivals grew bolder. So Cyaxan found new markets - darker ones.
undefined (Spanish): Con el tiempo, los márgenes se redujeron. Los rivales se volvieron más osados. Así que Cyaxan encontró nuevos mercados, mercados más oscuros.
undefined (Thai): แต่เมื่อเวลาพ้นผ่าน กำไรก็น้อยลง อริก็กล้ามากกว่าเดิม บ้าน\r\nไซยาซันจึงไปพบกับตลาดใหม่ ตลาดที่มืดมนนัก
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 隨著利潤越來越薄、競爭越來越激烈，塞亞珊家族從不法市場中看見契機。

string_8: Cyaxan didn't set out to rule the underworld. Only to survive it. Then survival turned to opportunity.
undefined (French): Cyaxan n'avait pas l'intention de régner sur le monde de la pègre. Seulement d'y survivre. Puis la survie s'est transformée en opportunité.
undefined (German): Am Anfang wollten die Cyaxan die Unterwelt nicht beherrschen. Sie wollten in ihr überleben. Doch dann ergaben sich aus dem Überleben Gelegenheiten.
undefined (Japanese): Cyaxan didn't set out to rule the underworld. Only to survive it. Then survival turned to opportunity.
undefined (Korean): 사이악산 가문이 처음부터 암흑가를 지배하려 했던 것은 아니다. 그들은 살아남기 위해 애썼고, 그 과정에서 기회가 찾아왔을 뿐이다.
undefined (Portuguese): Cyaxan não queria dominar o submundo, apenas sobreviver a ele. Mas logo viu uma oportunidade.
undefined (Russian): Cyaxan didn't set out to rule the underworld. Only to survive it. Then survival turned to opportunity.
undefined (Spanish): Cyaxan no se propuso dominar los bajos fondos. Solo sobrevivir en ellos. Después la supervivencia se convirtió en oportunidad.
undefined (Thai): บ้านไซยาซันไม่ได้ต้องการเป็นใหญ่ในโลกอาชญากรในตอนแรก\r\nเพียงแต่ต้องการเอาตัวรอด แล้วการเอาตัวรอดก็กลายเป็นโอกาส
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 塞亞珊家族無意治理地下世界，而是在其中求取一線生機和獲利的可能性。

string_8: Kylian Cyaxan's ascent to lord of the Trarthan underworld was not without obstacles. The first arose within his own house.
undefined (French): L'ascension de Kylian Cyaxan au rang de seigneur des bas-fonds trarthiens ne se fit pas sans heurt. Le premier obstacle provint même de sa propre maison.
undefined (German): Der Aufstieg Kylian Cyaxans zum Herrscher der trarthanischen Unterwelt war nicht ohne Hürden - die ersten erhoben sich in seinem eigenen Haus.
undefined (Japanese): Kylian Cyaxan's ascent to lord of the Trarthan underworld was not without obstacles. The first arose within his own house.
undefined (Korean): 트라투스 암흑가의 군주가 되기까지, 킬리안 사이악산은 온갖 장애물을 넘어야 했다. 그리고 그 첫 번째는 다름 아닌 본인의 가문에서 나왔다.
undefined (Portuguese): A ascensão de Kylian Cyaxan no submundo de Trarthus não foi simples, e os problemas começaram dentro de casa.
undefined (Russian): Kylian Cyaxan's ascent to lord of the Trarthan underworld was not without obstacles. The first arose within his own house.
undefined (Spanish): El ascenso de Kylian Cyaxan a señor de los bajos fondos de Trarthan no se produjo sin obstáculos. El primero surgió dentro de su propia casa.
undefined (Thai): ไคเลียน ไซยาซันมิได้เป็นนายเหนือโลกอาชญากรทาร์ทานได้\r\nอย่างไร้อุปสรรค อุปสรรคแรกมาจากบ้านของเขาเอง
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 奇里安．塞亞珊成為特拉特斯地下世界之首的過程並非一帆風順……他首先要克服的是手足的爭鬥。

string_8: Kylian's first victim wasn't a member of a rival House - it was family. From then on, betrayal became tradition.
undefined (French): La première victime de Kylian n'était pas un membre d'une maison rivale, mais de sa propre famille. Dès lors, la trahison devint tradition.
undefined (German): Kylians erstes Opfer war kein Mitglied eines rivalisierenden Hauses - es stammte aus der Familie. Von da an wurde Verrat zur Tradition.
undefined (Japanese): Kylian's first victim wasn't a member of a rival House - it was family. From then on, betrayal became tradition.
undefined (Korean): 킬리안의 첫 희생자는 경쟁 가문 사람이 아닌, 자신의 가족이었다. 그 후로 배신은 하나의 전통이 되었다.
undefined (Portuguese): A primeira vítima de Kylian não foi um rival, mas um parente. Isso fez da traição uma tradição.
undefined (Russian): Kylian's first victim wasn't a member of a rival House - it was family. From then on, betrayal became tradition.
undefined (Spanish): La primera víctima de Kylian no fue un miembro de una casa rival. Fue de su familia. Desde entonces, la traición se convirtió en tradición.
undefined (Thai): เหยื่อคนแรกของไซยาซันไม่ใช่สมาชิกบ้านคู่อริ แต่เป็นคนในตระกูล\r\nนับแต่นั้นเป็นต้นมา การทรยศจึงเป็นประเพณี
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 奇里安的第一個受害者不是敵對的家族，而是自己的手足。自此之後，背叛成為家族傳統。

string_8: Kylian Cyaxan never raised his voice. Just his glass. The rest of the table never stood again.
undefined (French): Kylian Cyaxan n'élevait jamais la voix, seulement son verre. Les autres convives restaient éternellement attablés.
undefined (German): Kylian Cyaxan erhob nie seine Stimme. Nur sein Glas. Die übrigen Gäste erhoben sich nie wieder.
undefined (Japanese): Kylian Cyaxan never raised his voice. Just his glass. The rest of the table never stood again.
undefined (Korean): 킬리안 사이악산은 목소리를 높이지 않았다. 그저 잔을 들었을 뿐. 그리고 식탁에 앉은 이들은 두 번 다시 일어서지 못했다.
undefined (Portuguese): Kylian Cyaxan nunca erguia a voz, só o cálice. E o resto da mesa nunca mais se levantava.
undefined (Russian): Kylian Cyaxan never raised his voice. Just his glass. The rest of the table never stood again.
undefined (Spanish): Kylian Cyaxan nunca alzaba la voz. Solo su vaso. El resto de los presente en la mesa nunca volvía a levantarse.
undefined (Thai): ไคเลียน ไซยาซันไม่เคยขึ้นเสียง เพียงแต่ยกแก้วเท่านั้น คนที่เหลือบน\r\nโต๊ะไม่ได้ยืนขึ้นอีกต่อไป
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 奇里安．塞亞珊從未提高他的音調，而是舉起他的酒杯。同桌諸人再也未起身。

string_8: With rivals dead or disgraced, Kylian moved fast - consolidating power, ensuring no Cyaxan could rise as he had.
undefined (French): Ses rivaux enterrés ou disgraciés, Kylian n'attendit pas pour agir. Il consolida son pouvoir et veilla à ce qu'aucun autre Cyaxan ne puisse gravir les échelons comme il l'avait fait.
undefined (German): Nachdem seine Rivalen tot oder in Ungnade gefallen waren, ging Kylian schnell vor - er festigte seine Macht und stellte sicher, dass kein anderer Cyaxan auf die gleiche Weise aufsteigen konnte.
undefined (Japanese): With rivals dead or disgraced, Kylian moved fast - consolidating power, ensuring no Cyaxan could rise as he had.
undefined (Korean): 경쟁자들이 모두 죽거나 실각하자, 킬리안은 빠르게 움직였다. 그는 사이악산 가문에서 자신처럼 세를 키워 부상하는 인물이 더 나오지 않도록 권력을 공고히 다졌다.
undefined (Portuguese): Com os rivais mortos ou humilhados, Kylian agiu rápido para firmar seu poder e garantir que ninguém mais da família teria a mesma chance.
undefined (Russian): With rivals dead or disgraced, Kylian moved fast - consolidating power, ensuring no Cyaxan could rise as he had.
undefined (Spanish): Con sus rivales muertos o caídos en desgracia, Kylian se movió rápido para consolidar su poder y asegurarse de que ningún Cyaxan pudiera alzarse como hizo él.
undefined (Thai): ในเมื่ออริตายหรือเสื่อมเสีย ไคเลียนจึงรีบเดินเกมอย่างรวดเร็ว\r\nรวมอำนาจไว้เป็นหนึ่ง ไม่ให้บ้านไซยาซันคนไหนเป็นใหญ่ได้อย่างเขา
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 在各方敵手相繼身亡或失勢後，奇里安迅速穩固權力，確保塞亞珊家族再無其他人可與他匹敵。

string_8: Kylian never trusted alliances. He preferred leverage. Internally, that meant secrets. Externally, sabotage.
undefined (French): Kylian ne comptait jamais sur les alliances ; il leur préférait les avantages sonnants et trébuchants. Sous le manteau, cela se traduisait par des secrets. Au grand jour, par des sabotages.
undefined (German): Kylian hatte kein Vertrauen in Allianzen. Er bevorzugte Einfluss. Innerhalb des Hauses bedeutete das Geheimnisse. Außerhalb - Sabotage.
undefined (Japanese): Kylian never trusted alliances. He preferred leverage. Internally, that meant secrets. Externally, sabotage.
undefined (Korean): 킬리안은 동맹을 믿지 않았으며, 영향력을 행사할 수단을 더 좋아했다. 가문 내에서는 비밀이, 외부에서는 파괴 공작이 그러한 수단이었다.
undefined (Portuguese): Kylian não confiava em alianças. Preferia ter vantagens, com segredos em casa e sabotagens no mundo.
undefined (Russian): Kylian never trusted alliances. He preferred leverage. Internally, that meant secrets. Externally, sabotage.
undefined (Spanish): Kylian nunca confió en las alianzas. Prefería tener influencia. Internamente, eso significaba secretos. Externamente, sabotaje.
undefined (Thai): ไคเลียนไม่ไว้ใจการผูกมิตร เขาชอบอำนาจต่อรองมากกว่า\r\nอำนาจภายในคือความลับ อำนาจภายนอกคือการบ่อนทำลาย
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 奇里安從不信任合縱連橫。他傾向對內保持秘密，對外則無所不用其極。

string_8: \"When dining with a Cyaxan, bring an appetite - and an antidote.\"
undefined (French): « Si vous dînez avec un Cyaxan, venez le ventre vide… et un antidote en poche. »
undefined (German): \"Wenn man mit einem Cyaxan speist, sollte man Appetit mitbringen - und ein Gegengift.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"When dining with a Cyaxan, bring an appetite - and an antidote.\"
undefined (Korean): \"사이악산 가문 사람과 식사할 때 챙길 준비물은 식욕... 그리고 해독제다.\"
undefined (Portuguese): \"Se for jantar com um cyaxano, leve fome e um antídoto.\"
undefined (Russian): \"When dining with a Cyaxan, bring an appetite - and an antidote.\"
undefined (Spanish): \"Si cenas con un Cyaxan, lleva apetito, y un antídoto\".
undefined (Thai): \"เวลาไปทานข้าวกับคนบ้านไซยาซัน เอาท้องไปกินข้าวแล้วอย่าลืม\r\nเอายาถอนพิษด้วย\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 「和塞亞珊家族的人用餐，必須接受盛情款待，也要隨身攜帶解毒劑保命。」

string_8: Cyaxan rarely availed themselves of House Azadi's services. They preferred less... bloody methods.
undefined (French): Les Cyaxan faisaient rarement appel aux services de la Maison Azadi. Ils préféraient des méthodes moins… sanglantes.
undefined (German): Cyaxan griffen nur selten auf die Dienste des Hauses Azadi zurück. Sie bevorzugten weniger … blutige Methoden.
undefined (Japanese): Cyaxan rarely availed themselves of House Azadi's services. They preferred less... bloody methods.
undefined (Korean): 사이악산은 아자디 가문을 고용하는 일이 드물었으며, 그보다 '평화로운' 수단을 선호했다.
undefined (Portuguese): Os cyaxanos raramente usavam os serviços da casa Azadi. Preferiam métodos menos... sangrentos.
undefined (Russian): Cyaxan rarely availed themselves of House Azadi's services. They preferred less... bloody methods.
undefined (Spanish): Los Cyaxan rara vez recurrían a los servicios de la Casa Azadi. Preferían métodos... menos sangrientos.
undefined (Thai): บ้านไซยาซันไม่ค่อยได้ใช้บริการของบ้านอะซาดินัก พวกเขาชอบวิธีที่...\r\nเปื้อนเลือดน้อยกว่า
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 塞亞珊家族鮮少尋求愛札丁家族的服務，畢竟他們……不喜雙手沾滿鮮血。

string_8: It wasn't people {0} Cyaxan loathed, but the frailties they wore so proudly: need, artifice, expectation.
undefined (French): Ce n'était pas les êtres humains qu'elle abhorrait, mais les fragilités qu'ils arboraient si fièrement : leurs besoins, leurs artifices, leurs attentes.
undefined (German): {0} Cyaxan hasste nicht die Menschen an sich, aber die Schwächen, die sie so stolz zur Schau stellten: Bedürfnisse, Tücke, Erwartungen.
undefined (Japanese): It wasn't people {0} Cyaxan loathed, but the frailties they wore so proudly: need, artifice, expectation.

undefined (Traditional Chinese): 當塵埃落定，從商戰得利者寥寥無幾，絕大多數只是可割可棄的棋子。

string_8: Cyaxan may have lit the fire. But when bodies piled high and profits ran dry, even Kylian sought peace.
undefined (French): Les Cyaxan avaient beau avoir avivé les flammes, même Kylian chercha la paix lorsque le compte de cadavres dépassa celui des bénéfices.
undefined (German): Haus Cyaxan hat mag das Feuer entzündet haben. Aber als sich die Leichen auftürmten und die Profite ausblieben, wollte selbst Kylian Frieden schließen.
undefined (Japanese): Cyaxan may have lit the fire. But when bodies piled high and profits ran dry, even Kylian sought peace.
undefined (Korean): 사이악산이 전쟁의 불씨를 당기기는 했지만, 시체가 쌓이고 돈줄이 말라가자 킬리안조차 평화를 원했다.
undefined (Portuguese): Cyaxan pode ter sido o estopim, mas, quando os corpos começaram a se empilhar e o lucro secou, até Kylian quis paz.

undefined (Spanish): Puede que Cyaxan haya encendido el fuego, pero cuando los cuerpos se apilaron y las ganancias se acabaron, hasta Kylian quiso que haya paz.
undefined (Thai): ไซยาซันอาจเป็นคนจุดไฟ แต่เมื่อศพกองสูงและกำไรเหือดแห้ง\r\nกระทั่งไคเลียนก็ยังแสวงหาสันติ
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 雖然戰火是由塞亞珊家族點燃，但當參戰雙方死傷枕藉、戰事已無利可圖，就連奇里安也願意談和。

string_8: The end of the Merchant Wars came not from diplomacy, but depletion. The Houses didn't shake hands - they paused to reload.
undefined (French): La paix ne se fit pas grâce à la diplomatie, mais plutôt par le manque. Les maisons ne se serrèrent pas la main ; elles s'interrompirent pour recharger.
undefined (German): Das Ende der Händlerkriege kam nicht durch Diplomatie zustande, sondern durch Erschöpfung. Die Häuser schüttelten nicht die Hände - sie pausierten, um sich neu zu bewaffnen.
undefined (Japanese): The end of the Merchant Wars came not from diplomacy, but depletion. The Houses didn't shake hands - they paused to reload.
undefined (Korean): 평화를 불러온 것은 외교가 아닌 고갈이었다. 가문들은 화해의 악수를 한 것이 아니라, 다시 화살을 메기기 위해 잠시 멈춘 것뿐이었다.
undefined (Portuguese): O fim das Guerras Comerciais não veio da diplomacia, mas do desgaste. As casas só pararam para recarregar as armas.
undefined (Russian): The end of the Merchant Wars came not from diplomacy, but depletion. The Houses didn't shake hands - they paused to reload.
undefined (Spanish): El fin de las Guerras de los mercaderes no llegó gracias a la diplomacia, sino a las carencias. Las casas no estrecharon sus manos, solo tomaron un descanso para recargar.
undefined (Thai): ความสงบสุขไม่ได้มาจากการทูต แต่มาจากความขาดแคลน\r\nบ้านต่างๆ ไม่ได้จับมือกัน เพียงแต่หยุดเพื่อเตรียมการใหม่เท่านั้น
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 和平並非來自外交斡旋，而是爭戰雙方資源的枯竭。雙方從未握手言和，而是趁這段期間養精蓄銳。

string_8: No House admits to starting the Merchant Wars. But every House claims to have won them.
undefined (French): Aucune maison n'admet avoir déclenché les guerres marchandes, mais toutes prétendent les avoir remportées.
undefined (German): Kein Haus gibt zu, die Händlerkriege begonnen zu haben. Aber jedes Haus behauptet, Sieger zu sein.
undefined (Japanese): No House admits to starting the Merchant Wars. But every House claims to have won them.
undefined (Korean): 상인 전쟁을 일으켰다고 인정하는 가문은 없지만, 모든 가문이 승자라 주장한다.
undefined (Portuguese): Nenhuma casa admite ter começado as Guerras Comerciais, mas todas juram que saíram vitoriosas.
undefined (Russian): No House admits to starting the Merchant Wars. But every House claims to have won them.
undefined (Spanish): Ninguna casa admite haber participado en la guerra de los mercaderes, pero todas las casas dicen haberla ganado.
undefined (Thai): ไม่มีบ้านไหนยอมรับว่าเป็นฝ่ายเริ่มสงครามพ่อค้า แต่ทุกบ้านอ้างว่า\r\nบ้านตนชนะสงครามนี้
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 無一家族否認戰事由他們而起，但也爭相宣告自己是贏家。

string_8: Some Cyaxans peddled pleasure, others poison. {0} Cyaxan peddled death.
undefined (French): Certains Cyaxan faisaient le commerce de plaisirs, d'autres de poisons. Pour elle, c'était la mort.
undefined (German): Einige Cyaxan handelten mit Vergnügungen, andere mit Giften. {0} Cyaxan verkaufte den Tod.
undefined (Japanese): Some Cyaxans peddled pleasure, others poison. {0} Cyaxan peddled death.
undefined (Korean): 사이악산 가문에는 쾌락을 파는 이도 있었고 독을 파는 이도 있었지만, 그녀는 죽음을 팔았다.
undefined (Portuguese): Alguns cyaxanos vendiam prazer, outros, veneno. {0} Cyaxan vendia a morte.
undefined (Russian): Some Cyaxans peddled pleasure, others poison. {0} Cyaxan peddled death.
undefined (Spanish): Algunos Cyaxan comerciaban con placer, otros con veneno. {0} Cyaxan comerciaba con la muerte.
undefined (Thai): คน​บ้าน​ไซยาซัน​บางคน​ขาย​ความ​เริงรมย์ บางคน​ขายพิษ {0} ไซยาซัน​ขาย​ความตาย
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 塞亞珊家族或兜售肉體的歡愉、或毒藥，她則是將死亡作為一門生意。

string_8: Even {0}'s fellow Cyaxans questioned her methods. But never their efficacy.
undefined (French): Même ses semblables remettaient ses méthodes en question, mais jamais leur efficacité.

undefined (Portuguese): Até os colegas cyaxanos de {0} questionavam seus métodos, mas nunca a eficácia.
undefined (Russian): Even {0}'s fellow Cyaxans questioned her methods. But never their efficacy.
undefined (Spanish): Hasta los compañeros Cyaxan de {0} cuestionaban sus métodos. Pero jamás su eficacia.
undefined (Thai): กระทั่ง​คน​ร่วม​บ้าน​ไซยาซัน​ยัง​กังขา​ใน​วิธีการ​ของ​{0} แต่​ไม่มี​ใคร​กังขา​ใน​ประสิทธิภาพ​แม้แต่​น้อย
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 塞亞珊家族的其他人對她的作為並不茍同，但無法否認她的行事果決。

string_8: Few in Trarthus kill with curses or corpses. But those who do face no fear of retribution.
undefined (French): Les malédictions et les revenants sont des outils rares, à Trarthus. Mais la mort reste la mort.
undefined (German): Wenige in Trarthus töten mit Flüchen oder Leichen. Aber die, die es tun, haben keine Angst vor Rache.
undefined (Japanese): Few in Trarthus kill with curses or corpses. But those who do face no fear of retribution.
undefined (Korean): 트라투스에서 저주와 언데드는 흔히 쓰이지 않지만, 죽음은 죽음이다.
undefined (Portuguese): Em Trarthus, poucos matam com maldições ou mortos-vivos. Mas os que fazem isso... não temem o troco.
undefined (Russian): Few in Trarthus kill with curses or corpses. But those who do face no fear of retribution.
undefined (Spanish): Pocos en Trarthus matan con maldiciones o cadáveres. Pero aquellos que lo hacen no temen las represalias.
undefined (Thai): ไม่ค่อยมีผู้ใดในทาร์ทัสที่เข่นฆ่าด้วยคำสาปหรือศพ แต่คนที่ทำเช่นนั้น\r\nไม่ต้องกลัวบทลงโทษใด
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 詛咒和復活之術在特拉特斯並不多見，但死人留下的軀殼能有點用也是好事。

string_8: \"They exiled their undesirables to Trarthus, and then had the gall to act surprised when those undesirables refused to bow down.\"
undefined (French): « Ils ont fait exiler les indésirables à Trarthus pendant des siècles et ont eu l'audace d'être surpris lorsque ces criminels indisciplinés ont refusé de se soumettre. »
undefined (German): \"Jahrhundertelang verbannten sie ihre Ausgestoßenen nach Trarthus und dann hatten sie die Unverfrorenheit, überrascht zu tun, als diese ungebührlichen Kriminellen sich weigerten, auf die Knie zu fallen.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"They exiled their undesirables to Trarthus, and then had the gall to act surprised when those undesirables refused to bow down.\"
undefined (Korean): \"수백 년 동안 못마땅한 사람들을 트라투스로 내쫓고는, 말 안 듣는 범죄자들이 제국에 고개를 조아리지 않는다며 놀란 척하는 꼴이라니.\"
undefined (Portuguese): \"Eles exilaram seus indesejados para Trarthus, e ainda fingiram surpresa quando essas pessoas se recusaram a se ajoelhar.\"
undefined (Russian): \"They exiled their undesirables to Trarthus, and then had the gall to act surprised when those undesirables refused to bow down.\"
undefined (Spanish): \"Exiliaron a sus indeseables a Trarthus durante siglos, y luego tuvieron el descaro de actuar sorprendidos cuando esos criminales descarriados se negaron a inclinarse\".
undefined (Thai): \"พวกมันเนรเทศผู้ที่ไม่พึงประสงค์ไปที่ทาร์ทัส แล้วยังมีหน้ามา\r\nประหลาดใจที่ผู้ที่ไม่พึงประสงค์พวกนั้นไม่ยอมศิโรราบ\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): \"They exiled their undesirables to Trarthus, and then had the gall to act surprised when those undesirables refused to bow down.\"

string_8: \"Witches aren't feared in Trarthus. They're adored. We wisely sided with the rebels against Little Tinny Phrecius.\"
undefined (French): « Personne ne craint les sorcières à Trarthus ; elles sont vénérées. Nous avons eu la sagesse de nous ranger du côté des rebelles contre l'adorable petit Phrécius. »
undefined (German): \"In Trarthus sind Hexen nicht gefürchtet. Sie werden bewundert. Wir haben uns in weiser Voraussicht mit den Rebellen gegen den kleinen Tinny Phrecius verbündet.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"Witches aren't feared in Trarthus. They're adored. We wisely sided with the rebels against Little Tinny Phrecius.\"
undefined (Korean): \"트라투스에서 마녀는 두려움의 대상이 아니야. 숭배의 대상이지. 우리가 틴다루스 프레시우스 녀석한테 맞선 반군과 손을 잡은 건 옳은 선택이었어.\"
undefined (Portuguese): \"Bruxas não metem medo em Trarthus. São adoradas. A gente teve juízo e ficou do lado dos rebeldes contra o tal do Pequenus Phrecius.\"
undefined (Russian): \"Witches aren't feared in Trarthus. They're adored. We wisely sided with the rebels against Little Tinny Phrecius.\"
undefined (Spanish): \"Nadie le teme a las brujas en Trarthus. Las adoran. Nos aliamos sabiamente con las rebeldes en contra del pequeñito Phrecius\".
undefined (Thai): \"ไม่มีใครกลัวแม่มดในทาร์ทัสดอก พวกเธอเป็นที่บูชาด้วยซ้ำ เรามี\r\nปัญญาพอที่จะเข้าข้างพวกกบฏในการต่อต้านทินนี่ ฟรีเชียส\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): \"Witches aren't feared in Trarthus. They're adored. We wisely sided with the rebels against Little Tinny Phrecius.\"

string_8: In Trarthus, faith never died. It just turned inward.
undefined (French): À Trarthus, la foi n'est jamais morte. Elle s'est simplement tournée vers l'intérieur.
undefined (German): In Trarthus ist der Glaube nie verschwunden. Er hat sich nur nach innen gerichtet.
undefined (Japanese): In Trarthus, faith never died. It just turned inward.
undefined (Korean): 트라투스에서 신앙은 죽지 않았다. 그저 내면으로 방향을 바꿨을 뿐이다.
undefined (Portuguese): A fé não desapareceu em Trarthus. Ela só se voltou para dentro.
undefined (Russian): In Trarthus, faith never died. It just turned inward.
undefined (Spanish): En Trarthus, la fe nunca murió. Solo se volvió hacia el interior.
undefined (Thai): ศรัทธาไม่เคยสิ้นลงในทาร์ทัส แต่กลายเป็นศรัทธาต่อภายในเมือง\r\nเท่านั้น
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 特拉特斯的信仰從未消亡，而是化為靈魂的一部分。

string_8: The major Houses didn't worship gods. They tried to become them.
undefined (French): Les grandes maisons ne vénéraient pas les dieux. Elles essayaient de prendre leur place.
undefined (German): Die großen Häuser beteten keine Götter an. Sie versuchten, welche zu werden.
undefined (Japanese): The major Houses didn't worship gods. They tried to become them.
undefined (Korean): 주요 가문들은 신을 섬기지 않았으며, 오히려 스스로 신이 되려 했다.
undefined (Portuguese): As grandes casas não cultuavam os deuses. Elas tentavam ser um.
undefined (Russian): The major Houses didn't worship gods. They tried to become them.
undefined (Spanish): Las casas grandes no veneraban a los dioses, trataron de convertirse en ellos.
undefined (Thai): บ้านใหญ่ไม่ได้สักการะเทพเจ้า แต่พยายามตั้งตนเป็นเทพเจ้าต่างหาก
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 大多數家族並不敬神，而是企圖成為神。

string_8: Divinity demands belief. Trarthus demanded proof.
undefined (French): La divinité nécessite la foi. Trarthus exigeait des preuves.
undefined (German): Göttlichkeit verlangt nach Glaube. Trarthus verlangte nach Beweisen.
undefined (Japanese): Divinity demands belief. Trarthus demanded proof.
undefined (Korean): 신성은 믿음을 요구하지만, 트라투스가 요구한 것은 증거였다.

undefined (Russian): Divinity demands belief. Trarthus demanded proof.
undefined (Spanish): La divinidad requiere de creencias. Trarthus quiso pruebas.
undefined (Thai): พลังเทวาต้องการความเชื่อ ทาร์ทัสต้องการหลักฐานพิสูจน์
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 神性講究的是信仰，而特拉特斯重視證據。

string_8: One claimed the mantle of flame. Another of blood. But in a city of rival 'gods', none rose above the noise.

undefined (German): Einer beanspruchte den Umhang der Flamme. Einer den des Blutes. Aber in einer Stadt mit rivalisierenden 'Göttern' konnte keiner über den Lärm erheben.
undefined (Japanese): One claimed the mantle of flame. Another of blood. But in a city of rival 'gods', none rose above the noise.
undefined (Korean): 불의 신을 자처한 자도 있었고, 피의 신을 자처한 자도 있었다. 하지만 경쟁 관계의 '신들'이 넘쳐나는 도시에서, 누구도 그 소란을 누르고 일어서지는 못했다.
undefined (Portuguese): Um se dizia senhor das chamas. Outro, do sangue. Mas em uma cidade cheia de \"deuses\" rivais, ninguém se impôs.
undefined (Russian): One claimed the mantle of flame. Another of blood. But in a city of rival 'gods', none rose above the noise.
undefined (Spanish): Uno reclamó el manto de las llamas. Otro el de la sangre. Pero en una ciudad de \"dioses\" rivales, ninguno logró sobresalir en el ruido.
undefined (Thai): มีคนครองผ้าคลุมเพลิง อีกคนครองผ้าคลุมเลือด แต่ในนครที่มี\r\n'เทพเจ้า' ที่เป็นอริมากมาย ไม่มีใครเป็นใหญ่เหนือความวุ่นวายได้
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 其中一個宣稱身批火炎、另一個則宣稱自己浸透鮮血，但這些「神」無一脫穎而出。

string_8: A House could rise through war, through gold, through secrets - but not through grace.
undefined (French): Une maison pouvait s'élever par la guerre, l'or ou les secrets, mais jamais par la grâce.

undefined (Japanese): A House could rise through war, through gold, through secrets - but not through grace.
undefined (Korean): 가문이 세를 불리는 방법에는 전쟁, 황금, 비밀 등이 있었지만, 품위는 그중 하나가 아니었다.
undefined (Portuguese): Guerra, ouro, intriga... era assim que uma casa crescia. Mas nunca com virtude.
undefined (Russian): A House could rise through war, through gold, through secrets - but not through grace.
undefined (Spanish): Una casa puede elevarse mediante la guerra, el oro o los secretos, pero nunca mediante gracia.
undefined (Thai): บ้านหนึ่งอาจตั้งตนเป็นใหญ่ได้ด้วยสงคราม ด้วยทอง ด้วยความลับ...\r\nแต่มิใช่ด้วยความสง่างาม
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 一個家族能脫穎而出的手段或為戰爭、或為金錢，或為秘密情報，但其中並無氣質出眾者。

string_8: Ixan Keita declared himself a god - and built temples to prove it. His slaves were given no choice but to pray.
undefined (French): Ixan Keita s'autoproclama dieu et fit construire un temple pour le prouver. Ses esclaves n'eurent d'autre choix que de prier.
undefined (German): Ixan Keita erklärte sich zu einem Gott - und baute Tempel, um es zu beweisen. Seine Sklaven hatten keine Wahl, als zu beten.

undefined (Korean): 익산 케이타는 자신이 신이라 선포하고, 이를 증명하기 위해 신전을 지었다. 그의 노예들은 강제로 기도하는 수밖에 없었다.
undefined (Portuguese): Ixan Keita se declarou um deus e construiu templos para convencer as pessoas disso. Seus escravos só podiam louvá-lo.
undefined (Russian): Ixan Keita declared himself a god - and built temples to prove it. His slaves were given no choice but to pray.
undefined (Spanish): Ixan Keita se declaró a sí mismo un dios, y construyó templos para probarlo. A sus esclavos les quedó más opción que rezar.

undefined (Traditional Chinese): 伊珊．凱塔宣稱自己是個神，並大興土木建成一座寺廟做為證明。他的奴隸們別無選擇，只能祈禱。

string_8: In his quest for Divinity, Ixan Keita demanded worship. Obedience was beaten in. But no man ever reached godhood through fear alone.
undefined (French): Dans sa quête de divinité, Keita exigea d'être vénéré. L'obéissance s'obtint à coups de fouet. Mais aucun homme ne devient dieu par la seule peur.
undefined (German): Auf seiner Suche nach Göttlichkeit verlangte Ixan Keita Anbetung. Gehorsam wurde durch Prügel erzwungen. Aber noch nie hat jemand die Göttlichkeit durch Furcht alleine erreicht.
undefined (Japanese): In his quest for Divinity, Ixan Keita demanded worship. Obedience was beaten in. But no man ever reached godhood through fear alone.
undefined (Korean): 케이타는 신이 되기 위해 숭배를 요구했고, 따르지 않는 자는 폭력으로 다스렸다. 하지만 두려움만으로 신이 된 자는 지금껏 한 명도 없었다.
undefined (Portuguese): Na busca para se tornar um deus, Ixan Keita exigia adoração. A obediência era forçada. Mas ninguém chega à divindade só pelo medo.
undefined (Russian): In his quest for Divinity, Ixan Keita demanded worship. Obedience was beaten in. But no man ever reached godhood through fear alone.
undefined (Spanish): En su misión para alcanzar la divinidad, Ixan Keita exigió veneración. La obediencia se lograba con golpes. Pero ningún hombre llegó a ser un dios usando solo el miedo.
undefined (Thai): อิกซาน เคย์ทาแสวงหาพลังเทวาด้วยการสั่งให้ผู้คนสักการะ ทุบตีให้\r\nเชื่อฟัง แต่ไม่มีใครได้เป็นเทพเจ้าด้วยความกลัวเพียงอย่างเดียว
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 在企圖掌握神性的過程中，凱塔要求人們向他膜拜，不從者一概鞭笞。然從古至今無人仰賴恐懼獲得神格。

string_8: They sang of Ixan Keita, knelt in his hollow shrines... but their hearts spoke only of hate.
undefined (French): Ils chantaient les louanges d'Ixan Keita, s'agenouillaient dans ses sanctuaires vides… mais leur cœur n'était que haine.
undefined (German): Sie besangen Ixan Keita, knieten in seinen leeren Schreinen … aber ihre Herzen waren voller Hass.
undefined (Japanese): They sang of Ixan Keita, knelt in his hollow shrines... but their hearts spoke only of hate.
undefined (Korean): 사람들은 익산 케이타에 대한 찬송을 부르고, 그의 공허한 신전 앞에 무릎 꿇었다. 그러나 그들의 마음에 깃든 건 오직 증오뿐이었다.
undefined (Portuguese): Cantavam o nome de Ixan Keita, ajoelhavam em templos vazios... No fundo, porém, só sentiam ódio.
undefined (Russian): They sang of Ixan Keita, knelt in his hollow shrines... but their hearts spoke only of hate.
undefined (Spanish): Cantaron sobre Ixan Keita, se arrodillaron en sus santuarios vacíos… pero sus corazones solo contenían odio.
undefined (Thai): พวกเขาร้องเพลงเกี่ยวกับอิกซาน เคย์ทา คุกเข่าในอารามกลวงๆ...\r\nแต่ใจพวกเขาพูดออกมาเพียงความเกลียดชังเท่านั้น
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 他們歌頌伊珊．凱塔、在他空蕩的神殿中雙膝跪地……但他們的心中只有怨懟。

string_8: Ixan mistook silence for reverence. In truth, not one soul believed. And so he remained just that: a mortal soul.
undefined (French): Ixan prit leur silence pour du respect. En vérité, aucune âme ne croyait en lui. Il demeura donc ce qu'il avait toujours été : un simple mortel.
undefined (German): Ixan hielt die Stille für Verehrung. In Wahrheit glaubte niemand an ihn. So blieb er, was er war - eine sterbliche Seele.
undefined (Japanese): Ixan mistook silence for reverence. In truth, not one soul believed. And so he remained just that: a mortal soul.
undefined (Korean): 익산은 그 침묵을 경외심이라 착각했다. 그러나 사실 단 한 명도 그를 믿지 않았다. 그래서 그는 끝내 필멸자를 벗어나지 못했다.
undefined (Portuguese): Ixan confundia silêncio com adoração. Mas ninguém acreditava nele. No fim, ele continuou sendo só isso: um homem comum.
undefined (Russian): Ixan mistook silence for reverence. In truth, not one soul believed. And so he remained just that: a mortal soul.
undefined (Spanish): Ixan malinterpretó el silencio como reverencia. Pero en verdad, ningún alma creía en él. Y así, siempre se mantuvo solo eso: un alma mortal.
undefined (Thai): อิกซานหลงเชื่อว่าความเงียบงันคือการบูชา แต่ที่จริงไม่มีใครสักคน\r\nที่เชื่อ เขาจึงเป็นเช่นเดิม เป็นวิญญาณที่ไม่จีรังอยู่ร่ำไป
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 伊珊將諸人的沉默視為敬畏。在場諸人無一真心崇敬，因此他始終僅有一副血肉之軀。

string_8: \"Let them hate me, if they must. Even hatred bows to power.\"\r\n - Ixan Keita
undefined (French): « Qu'ils me haïssent, s'ils le désirent. Même la haine plie face au pouvoir. » — Ixan Keita
undefined (German): \"Lasst sie mich hassen, wenn sie müssen. Selbst Hass beugt sich der Macht.\" \r\n– Ixan Keita
undefined (Japanese): \"Let them hate me, if they must. Even hatred bows to power.\"\r\n - Ixan Keita
undefined (Korean): \"날 증오해야만 한다면 말리지 않겠다. 증오라도 힘 앞에서는 고개를 숙이는 법이다.\" - 익산 케이타
undefined (Portuguese): \"Podem me odiar, se quiserem. Até o ódio se curva ao poder.\"\r\n- Ixan Keita
undefined (Russian): \"Let them hate me, if they must. Even hatred bows to power.\"\r\n - Ixan Keita
undefined (Spanish): \"Deja que me odien si es necesario. Hasta el odio se inclina ante el poder\".\r\n- Ixan Keita
undefined (Thai): \"พวกมันจะเกลียดข้าก็เกลียดไป กระทั่งความเกลียดชังยังพ่ายให้\r\nแก่พลัง\" - อิกซาน เคย์ทา
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 「就算他們憎恨我，還是得對力量低頭。」- 伊珊．凱塔

string_8: They preached in alleyways and taverns. Few listened. Fewer remembered.
undefined (French): Ils prêchèrent dans les ruelles et les tavernes. Rares sont ceux qui les écoutèrent, plus rare encore sont ceux qui s'en souvinrent.
undefined (German): Sie predigten in Gassen und Tavernen. Wenige hörten zu. Noch weniger erinnerten sich.
undefined (Japanese): They preached in alleyways and taverns. Few listened. Fewer remembered.
undefined (Korean): 그들은 골목에서, 주점에서 말씀을 전했다. 귀를 기울이는 자는 적었고, 기억하는 자는 더 적었다.
undefined (Portuguese): Pregavam em becos e tavernas. Poucos ligavam. Quase ninguém se lembrava.
undefined (Russian): They preached in alleyways and taverns. Few listened. Fewer remembered.
undefined (Spanish): Predicaban en callejones y tabernas. Pocos escuchaban. Pocos recordaron.
undefined (Thai): พวกเขาเทศน์ในซอยและโรงเหล้า ไม่ค่อยมีคนฟัง แทบไม่มีใครจดจำ
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 他們在大街小巷、酒肆市集裡弘法，願意聆聽者寥寥無幾，銘記在心者更是屈指可數。

string_8: Attempts to bring organised religion to Trarthus were many - and all of them met with blood.
undefined (French): Nombreuses furent les tentatives d'imposer une religion organisée à Trarthus ; toutes finirent en bain de sang.
undefined (German): Es gab viele Versuche, organisierte Religion nach Trarthus zu bringen - sie alle endeten mit Blutvergießen.
undefined (Japanese): Attempts to bring organised religion to Trarthus were many - and all of them met with blood.
undefined (Korean): 그간 트라투스에 조직화된 종교를 전파하기 위한 숱한 시도가 있었지만, 결과는 하나같이 참혹했다.
undefined (Portuguese): Tentaram impor a religião em Trarthus diversas vezes, e todas acabaram em sangue.
undefined (Russian): Attempts to bring organised religion to Trarthus were many - and all of them met with blood.
undefined (Spanish): Hubo muchos intentos para llevar la religión organizada a Trarthus, y todos terminaron con sangre.
undefined (Thai): มีหลายคนพยายามเผยแผ่ศาสนาในทาร์ทัส ทุกครั้งลงเอยด้วยเลือด\r\nอยู่ร่ำไป
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 嘗試在特拉特斯宣教者不在少數……大多演變為血濺現場的全武行。

string_8: Faith is tolerated in Trarthus - but only so long as it is kept to one's self.
undefined (French): La foi est tolérée à Trarthus, tant que vous la gardez pour vous.
undefined (German): Glaube wird in Trarthus toleriert - aber nur, solange man ihn für sich behält.
undefined (Japanese): Faith is tolerated in Trarthus - but only so long as it is kept to one's self.
undefined (Korean): 트라투스에서는 신념이 용인된다. 단, 신념을 혼자서 간직하는 경우에 한해서다.
undefined (Portuguese): A fé é tolerada em Trarthus, desde que seja mantida em sigilo.
undefined (Russian): Faith is tolerated in Trarthus - but only so long as it is kept to one's self.
undefined (Spanish): En Trarthus se tolera la fe, pero siempre y cuando se practique en el interior.
undefined (Thai): ทาร์ทัสไม่ถือสาถ้าใครจะศรัทธาในศาสนาใด ตราบใดที่เขาคนนั้นเก็บ\r\nศรัทธาไว้กับตัว
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 特拉特斯對信仰持容忍態度……前提是信仰必須僅止於個人內心。

string_8: Even the pious stray in Trarthus - led not by devils, but by gold and supple skin.
undefined (French): Même les plus pieux s'égarent à Trarthus, séduits non par les diables, mais par l'or et la douceur de la peau.
undefined (German): Selbst die Gottesfürchtigen kommen in Trarthus vom Weg ab - nicht verführt von Teufeln, sondern von Gold und weichem Fleisch.
undefined (Japanese): Even the pious stray in Trarthus - led not by devils, but by gold and supple skin.
undefined (Korean): 트라투스에서는 경건한 자도 탈선하고 만다. 악마가 아닌, 황금과 부드러운 살결에 이끌려.
undefined (Portuguese): Até o mais santo se desvia em Trarthus. Não por demônios, mas por ouro e prazer carnal.
undefined (Russian): Even the pious stray in Trarthus - led not by devils, but by gold and supple skin.
undefined (Spanish): Hasta los piadosos erran el camino en Trarthus, y no porque los guíen los demonios, sino el oro y el suave toque de la piel.
undefined (Thai): กระทั่งผู้เคร่งศาสนาก็เตลิดได้ในทาร์ทัส... มิได้ถูกชักนำด้วยปีศาจ\r\nแต่ชักนำด้วยทองและผิวที่เนียนนุ่ม
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 虔誠者在特拉特斯也難以安身立命，他們充其量不過是待宰的羔羊。

string_8: Trarthans revere but one god: the almighty coin.
undefined (French): Les Trathiens ne vénèrent qu'une seule déesse : la toute-puissante piécette.
undefined (German): Trarthaner verehren nur einen Gott: das allmächtige Geld.
undefined (Japanese): Trarthans revere but one god: the almighty coin.
undefined (Korean): 트라투스인이 숭배하는 신은 단 하나, 전능하신 돈뿐이다.
undefined (Portuguese): Os trarthanos só se curvam a um deus todo-poderoso: o dinheiro.
undefined (Russian): Trarthans revere but one god: the almighty coin.
undefined (Spanish): Los trarthanos veneran a un solo dios: el todopoderoso dinero.
undefined (Thai): ชาวทาร์ทานเคารพเทพเจ้าเพียงองค์เดียว เหรียญผู้ยิ่งใหญ่
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 閃耀的錢幣是特拉特斯的唯一真神。

string_8: \"If your mission should take you to Trarthus, you'd best carry a knife.\"\r\n - Gospel and Blade
undefined (French): « Si votre mission vous mène à Trarthus, pensez à porter un couteau. » — Lames et paroles divines
undefined (German): \"Sollte Euch Eure Mission nach Trarthus führen, solltet Ihr lieber ein Messer dabeihaben.\" \r\n– Evangelium und Klinge
undefined (Japanese): \"If your mission should take you to Trarthus, you'd best carry a knife.\"\r\n - Gospel and Blade
undefined (Korean): \"혹여 임무 때문에 트라투스로 가게 된다면 단도를 챙기는 것이 좋다.\" - 가스펠과 블레이드
undefined (Portuguese): \"Se sua missão te levar a Trarthus, melhor não ir sem uma faca.\"\r\n- Evangelho e Espada
undefined (Russian): \"If your mission should take you to Trarthus, you'd best carry a knife.\"\r\n - Gospel and Blade
undefined (Spanish): \"Si tu misión fuese a llevarte a Trarthus, será mejor que lleves una navaja\".\r\n- Góspel y cuchillos
undefined (Thai): \"หากการเผยแผ่ศาสนานำเจ้าไปสู่ทาร์ทัส เจ้าพกมีดเสียดีกว่า\"\r\n- คำเทศน์และมีด
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 「如果你接到的任務派你前往特拉特斯，最好隨身攜帶一把短刀。」- 《福音與刀刃》

string_8: Once Emperor Tyndarus caught wind of Trarthan warlords setting up a society, he sent his legions to stomp them back down.
undefined (French): « Lorsque l'Empereur Tyndarus apprit que les seigneurs de guerre trarthiens avaient établi des cultures et une société à part entière, il fit envoyer ses légions sans attendre afin de les écraser sous sa botte. »
undefined (German): Als Kaiser Tyndarus davon hörte, dass trarthanische Kriegsherren damit begonnen hatten, eine Gesellschaft zu gründen, schickte er sofort seine Legionen, um sie wieder in den Staub zu treten.

undefined (Traditional Chinese): Once Emperor Tyndarus caught wind of Trarthan warlords setting up a society, he sent his legions to stomp them back down.

string_8: The Phrecian legions executed the warlords of that era, and instituted crushing taxes on the budding Trarthan society.

undefined (Portuguese): As legiões firecianas executaram os senhores da guerra da época e impuseram impostos absurdos à sociedade trarthana que ainda estava nascendo.
