undefined (Traditional Chinese): The Phrecian legions executed the warlords of that era, and instituted crushing taxes on the budding Trarthan society.

string_8: Some foreigners cling to warm memories of Divinity. In Trarthus, that's considered true madness.
undefined (French): Certains étrangers se raccrochent aux doux souvenirs de la Divinité. À Trarthus, ils sont considérés comme de véritables déments.
undefined (German): Manche Fremde klammern sich an wärmende Erinnerungen von Göttlichkeit. In Trarthus hält man das für reinen Irrsinn.
undefined (Japanese): Some foreigners cling to warm memories of Divinity. In Trarthus, that's considered true madness.
undefined (Korean): 신성의 따스한 기억을 간직하는 외지인이 간혹 있다. 트라투스에서 이는 심한 정신 착란으로 여겨진다.

undefined (Spanish): Algunos forasteros se aferraron a los cálidos recuerdos de la divinidad. En Trarthus, eso se considera locura.
undefined (Thai): คนต่ายถิ่นบางคนยึดความทรงจำเกี่ยวกับพลังเทวาอันอบอุ่นเป็น\r\nสรณะ ซึ่งเป็นเรื่องที่ถูกมองว่าบ้าคลั่งอย่างแท้จริงในทาร์ทัส
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 異國人往往會以神性的溫暖記憶做為慰藉，這種行為在特拉特斯被視為真正的瘋狂之舉。

string_8: Trarthans know Innocence not as a god, but as a tale told by passing missionaries - and quickly forgotten.
undefined (French): Les trarthiens connaissent Innocence non pas en tant que dieu, mais en tant que conte transmis par des missionnaires de passage et aussitôt oublié.
undefined (German): Trarthaner kennen Innocence nicht als Gott, sondern als eine Geschichte, erzählt von Missionaren auf der Durchreise - die sie alsbald wieder vergaßen.
undefined (Japanese): Trarthans know Innocence not as a god, but as a tale told by passing missionaries - and quickly forgotten.
undefined (Korean): 트라투스인에게 이노센스는 신이 아니다. 그저 지나가는 선교사한테서 주워들었다가 금세 잊어버리는 이야기에 불과하다.
undefined (Portuguese): Em Trarthus, Inocência não é um deus, mas uma história irrelevante contada por missionários de passagem.
undefined (Russian): Trarthans know Innocence not as a god, but as a tale told by passing missionaries - and quickly forgotten.
undefined (Spanish): Los trarthanos conocen a Inocencia no como un dios, sino como una historia que cuentan los misioneros viajeros… que pronto se olvida.
undefined (Thai): ชาวทาร์ทานมิได้รู้จักอินโนเซนในฐานะเทพเจ้า แต่เป็นเรื่องเล่าขาน\r\nของผู้เผยแผ่ศาสนาที่สัญจร และถูกลืมเลือนอย่างรวดเร็ว
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 「善」在特拉特斯人眼中並非神祇，僅是從途經的傳教士口中得知的故事……但這些話轉個頭就忘了。

string_8: \"A fire that does not warm, does not feed, does not kill... what use is it in Trarthus?\"
undefined (French): « Un feu qui ne réchauffe pas, ne nourrit pas, ne tue pas… Quelle pourrait être son utilité à Trarthus ? »
undefined (German): \"Ein Feuer, das nicht wärmt, nicht nährt, nicht tötet … welchen Nutzen hat es denn in Trarthus?\"
undefined (Japanese): \"A fire that does not warm, does not feed, does not kill... what use is it in Trarthus?\"

undefined (Spanish): \"Un fuego que no calienta, ni alimenta ni mata… ¿qué utilidad podría tener en Trarthus?
undefined (Thai): \"ไฟที่ไม่ทำให้อบอุ่น ไม่ทำให้อิ่มท้อง ไม่ฆ่า... มีประโยชน์อะไรในทาร์ทัส\r\nเล่า?\"

undefined (Russian): Innocence preaches purity. Trarthus breeds survival. The two have little in common.

undefined (Thai): อินโนเซนสอนเรื่องความพิสุทธ์ ทาร์ทัสบ่มเพาะการเอาตัวรอด\r\nสองสิ่งนี้หาได้ใกล้เคียงกันไม่
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 善追求純粹，而特拉特斯只為下一頓飯作打算，兩者毫無交集。

string_8: \"When they call Korathin a city of sin, they're not talking about the god.\"
undefined (French): « Quand on dit que Korathin est une ville de péché, on ne parle pas du dieu. »

undefined (Japanese): \"When they call Korathin a city of sin, they're not talking about the god.\"
undefined (Korean): \"코라틴은 죄악의 도시라고 불리지. 씬을 가리키는 게 아니라, 글자 그대로의 죄악 말이야.\"
undefined (Portuguese): \"Quando chamam Korathin de cidade do pecado, não estão falando do deus.\"
undefined (Russian): \"When they call Korathin a city of sin, they're not talking about the god.\"
undefined (Spanish): \"Cuando llaman a Korathin «ciudad de pecado» no se refieren al dios\".
undefined (Thai): \"เวลาที่คนบอกว่าโคราธินเป็นนครแห่งบาป เขาไม่ได้พูดถึงเทพเจ้า\r\nที่ชื่อว่าซิน\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 「他們稱科拉廷為罪孽之城，但他們所指的『罪』並非神祇。」

string_8: \"Some say there's no honour left in Korathin. Others say it never belonged here to begin with.\"
undefined (French): « Certains disent que cette ville n'a plus une once d'honneur. D'autres qu'elle n'en a jamais connu. »
undefined (German): \"Einige sagen, dass es in Korathin keine Ehre mehr gibt. Andere sagen, dass sie noch nie hierher gehörte.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"Some say there's no honour left in Korathin. Others say it never belonged here to begin with.\"
undefined (Korean): \"혹자는 이 도시에서 더는 영광을 찾아볼 수 없다고 하지만, 다른 이는 말하지. 영광은 처음부터 존재한 적 없었다고.\"
undefined (Portuguese): \"Uns dizem que Korathin perdeu sua honra. Outros dizem que ela nunca existiu por aqui.\"
undefined (Russian): \"Some say there's no honour left in Korathin. Others say it never belonged here to begin with.\"
undefined (Spanish): Algunos dicen que ya no queda honor en Korathin. Otros dicen que jamás lo hubo.
undefined (Thai): \"บ้างบอกว่าโคราธินไม่มีเกียรติ บ้างบอกว่าเกียรติไม่เหมาะกับที่นี่\r\nตั้งแต่แรก\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 「有些人聲稱這座城市毫無榮譽感，有些人則表示榮譽一向不是此處追尋的價值。」

string_8: A good deed in Trarthus gets you one thing: a target on your back.
undefined (French): Une bonne action à Trarthus ne vous apportera qu'une seule chose : une cible dans votre dos.

undefined (Japanese): A good deed in Trarthus gets you one thing: a target on your back.
undefined (Korean): 트라투스에서 선행을 베풀면 돌아오는 것은 표적이 되는 일뿐이다.
undefined (Portuguese): Fazer o bem em Trarthus só serve para pintar um alvo nas suas costas.

undefined (Spanish): Una buena acción en Trarthus solo te otorga una cosa: un objetivo en tu espalda.

undefined (Traditional Chinese): 在特拉特斯行善只會讓你成為眾矢之的。

string_8: \"What's a man to do with morals, when no one else plays by them?\"
undefined (French): « À quoi bon respecter un ordre moral si vous êtes la seule personne à l'honorer ? »
undefined (German): \"Was soll ein Mann mit Moralvorstellungen anfangen, wenn sich sonst niemand nach ihnen richtet?\"
undefined (Japanese): \"What's a man to do with morals, when no one else plays by them?\"
undefined (Korean): \"따르는 자가 아무도 없다면 도덕 따위가 대체 무슨 소용이지?\"

undefined (Russian): \"What's a man to do with morals, when no one else plays by them?\"
undefined (Spanish): \"¿De qué le sirve la moral a un hombre si los demás no le prestan atención?\"
undefined (Thai): \"คนคนนึงจะเอาศีลธรรมไปทำอะไร ในเมื่อไม่มีใครเล่นตามศีลธรรมกัน\r\nเลย\"

string_8: Even in Trarthus, someone buries the bodies. Someone remembers the names.

undefined (Portuguese): Em Trarthus, ainda há quem enterre os mortos e guarde seus nomes.

undefined (Traditional Chinese): 特拉特斯也有人埋葬死者、緬懷他們的過往。

string_8: Some virtues endure - not in law, nor gods, but in spite of both.
undefined (French): Certaines vertus persistent, non par la loi ou les dieux, mais justement malgré eux.

undefined (Korean): 어떤 미덕은 살아남는다. 법이나 신 따위를 통해서가 아니라, 그 둘을 견디고 살아남는 것이다.

undefined (Thai): ความดีบางอย่างยังยืนยง ใช่ว่าเพราะไร้กฎ ใช่ว่าเพราะไร้เทพ แต่แม้\r\nจะมีกฎหรือเทพอยู่ก็ตาม
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 有些美德尚存，但並非存在於律法或神祇之中，而是對兩者的憎惡。

string_8: The surest way to frighten Ixan Keita was kindness. Always hunting for an angle, he could never see it for what it was.
undefined (French): La meilleure façon d'effrayer Ixan Keita était de faire preuve de bonté. Toujours à la recherche d'un angle d'attaque, il ne put jamais voir la bienveillance d'un acte désintéressé.
undefined (German): Der sicherste Weg, Ixan Keita Angst einzujagen, war Güte. Auch wenn er nach immer neuen Ansätzen suchte, konnte er doch nie ihr Wesen erkennen.
undefined (Japanese): The surest way to frighten Ixan Keita was kindness. Always hunting for an angle, he could never see it for what it was.
undefined (Korean): 익산 케이타를 어김없이 두렵게 하는 것은 친절이었다. 언제나 모략을 꾸미는 그에게 친절을 곧이곧대로 받아들이기란 불가능했다.
undefined (Portuguese): A melhor forma de assustar Ixan Keita era com gentileza. Sempre desconfiado, vivia procurando segundas intenções.
undefined (Russian): The surest way to frighten Ixan Keita was kindness. Always hunting for an angle, he could never see it for what it was.
undefined (Spanish): La mejor forma de asustar a Keita era con amabilidad. Al estar siempre buscando el ángulo correcto, nunca pudo verla por lo que era.
undefined (Thai): วิธีที่ดีที่สุดที่จะทำให้อิกซาน เคย์ทาเกรงกลัวคือการให้ความเมตตา\r\nเขามองหาเหลี่ยมอยู่เสมอ จึงไม่อาจมองเห็นในสิ่งที่มันเป็น

string_8: Keita drew brutes from every corner - sadists, zealots, and worse. What bound them was a taste for cruelty.
undefined (French): Keita dénicha ses brutes dans tous les recoins de la société : sadiques, zélotes et autres tortionnaires de la pire espèce, tous se retrouvaient dans leur goût pour la cruauté.

undefined (Korean): 케이타는 곳곳에서 짐승들을 끌어들였다. 잔학한 자들, 맹신자들, 그보다 더한 자들을. 이들은 잔혹한 취미 아래 하나로 묶였다.

string_8: They mocked {0} Keita's prayers. Until one day, the sinner burned, and they said nothing more.

undefined (Traditional Chinese): In 870 IC, the four great Founders spurred their guerrilla rebellion into open warfare against the occupying legions.

string_8: It took two years of open warfare, but Tyndarus finally capitulated in exchange for the lives of his legions.

string_8: Trarthus was lawless once - but not without rules. Some approached the Death Trades with grace... and surprising decorum.
undefined (French): Trarthus était un lieu sans loi autrefois, mais pas sans règles. Certains approchaient des commerces mortels avec grâce… et un décorum parfois surprenant.
undefined (German): Einst war Trarthus gesetzlos - aber nicht ohne Regeln. Einige wandten sich dem Handel mit dem Tod zu mit Eleganz ... und überraschendem Anstand.\"
undefined (Japanese): Trarthus was lawless once - but not without rules. Some approached the Death Trades with grace... and surprising decorum.

undefined (Traditional Chinese): 特拉特斯曾經毫無律法……但仍有一套生存法則：有些人對死亡交易行禮如儀。

string_8: Before the Merchant Wars. Before the Council. Before Trarthus had a name. There was the Code.
undefined (French): Avant les guerres marchandes, avant le conseil, avant que Trarthus n'ait de nom, il existait le Code.
undefined (German): Vor den Händlerkriegen. Vor dem Rat. Bevor Trarthus einen Namen hatte. Gab es die Tradition.
undefined (Japanese): Before the Merchant Wars. Before the Council. Before Trarthus had a name. There was the Code.
undefined (Korean): 상인 전쟁 전에, 의회가 생기기 전에, 트라투스에 이름이 붙기도 전에, 규율이 있었다.
undefined (Portuguese): Antes das Guerras Comerciais, do conselho e de Trarthus ter um nome, o código já existia.

undefined (German): Die vier großen Gründer waren einst ungewollte Verbündete, die einen Guerilla-Krieg gegen die Legionen des Besatzers führten.

undefined (Portuguese): As quatro grandes casas já foram aliadas relutantes, unidas na guerrilha contra as legiões ocupantes.
undefined (Russian): The four Great Houses were once begrudging allies, fighting a guerilla war against occupying legions.
undefined (Spanish): Las cuatro Grandes Casas una vez fueron aliados reticentes para luchar en una guerra de guerrillas contra las legiones de ocupación.

undefined (Traditional Chinese): The four Great Houses were once begrudging allies, fighting a guerilla war against occupying legions.

string_8: Violence has always been common in Trarthus. But it was Ratha Azadi who commodified it - turned it into an art form all her own.
undefined (French): La violence a toujours été monnaie courante à Trarthus, mais ce fut Ratha Azadi qui l'harmonisa et la transforma en art à part entière.
undefined (German): Gewalt war in Trarthus schon immer weit verbreitet. Aber es war Ratha Azadi, die sie zu einer Ware machte - und zu einer ihr eigenen Kunstform.
undefined (Japanese): Violence has always been common in Trarthus. But it was Ratha Azadi who commodified it - turned it into an art form all her own.
undefined (Korean): 트라투스에서는 늘 폭력이 흔히 자행되었다. 하지만 그것을 상품화하여 자기만의 예술로 바꾼 인물은 라타 아자디였다.
undefined (Portuguese): Trarthus sempre foi violenta. Mas foi Ratha Azadi que transformou isso num espetáculo... e num negócio.
undefined (Russian): Violence has always been common in Trarthus. But it was Ratha Azadi who commodified it - turned it into an art form all her own.
undefined (Spanish): La violencia siempre ha sido algo habitual en Trarthus. Pero fue Ratha Azadi quien la mercantilizó; la convirtió en una forma de arte.
undefined (Thai): ความรุนแรงพบได้ทั่วทั้งทาร์ทัส แต่ราธา อะซาดิทำให้มันเป็นสินค้า...\r\nเปลี่ยนมันเป็นศิลปะด้วยตัวเธอเอง
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 施暴在特拉特斯並不少見，而菈妲．愛札丁將它化為商機，造就獨樹一格的藝術型態。

string_8: Azadi distinguished itself not through efficiency, but through audacious spectacle. Azadins didn't kill. They wove death itself.
undefined (French): Les Azadi se distinguèrent non par leur efficacité, mais par leurs spectacles audacieux. Ils ne tuaient pas ; ils tissaient l'étoffe même de la mort.
undefined (German): Haus Azadi tat sich nicht durch Effizienz hervor, sondern durch kühnes Spektakel. Azadi töteten nicht. Sie schufen Kunstwerke.
undefined (Japanese): Azadi distinguished itself not through efficiency, but through audacious spectacle. Azadins didn't kill. They wove death itself.
undefined (Korean): 아자디는 효율이 아니라 대담한 볼거리로 스스로를 차별화했다. 아자디 가문 사람들은 그저 죽이는 게 아니라, 죽음 그 자체를 엮었다.
undefined (Portuguese): Os azadinos não se distinguiam pela eficiência, mas pela obra. Em vez de matar, transformavam a morte num espetáculo.
undefined (Russian): Azadi distinguished itself not through efficiency, but through audacious spectacle. Azadins didn't kill. They wove death itself.
undefined (Spanish): Azadi se distinguía no por su eficiencia, sino por su audaz espectáculo. Los Azadin no mataban. Tejían la muerte.
undefined (Thai): บ้านอะซาดิมิได้โดดเด่นด้วยประสิทธิภาพ แต่ด้วยความกล้าหาญ\r\nน่าดูชม บ้านอะซาดิมิได้ฆ่า แต่ร่ายรำกับความตายเสียเอง
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 愛札丁家族的卓越，不在於效率，而在於其大膽張揚的表現。愛札丁不只是殺戮──他們是死亡的編織者。

string_8: Ratha Azadi understood that killing goes beyond the act itself. Some kills live longer than the killer - but only when done right.
undefined (French): Ratha comprit qu'un assassinat ne se limitait pas à l'acte même. Certains meurtres pouvaient survivre à leur auteur, à condition d'être commis comme il se doit.
undefined (German): Ratha Azadi war sich bewusst, dass das Töten mehr als nur der Akt selbst war. Manche Morde überdauern den Mörder - aber nur, wenn man es richtig macht.
undefined (Japanese): Ratha Azadi understood that killing goes beyond the act itself. Some kills live longer than the killer - but only when done right.
undefined (Korean): 라타는 살인에 그 행위 자체를 넘어서는 의미가 있다고 생각했다. 어떤 살인은 살인자보다도 오래가지만, 제대로 했을 때만 그럴 수 있다.
undefined (Portuguese): Ratha Azadi sabia que matar ia além do ato em si. Algumas mortes duram mais que o próprio matador, se forem bem-feitas.
undefined (Russian): Ratha Azadi understood that killing goes beyond the act itself. Some kills live longer than the killer - but only when done right.
undefined (Spanish): Ratha Azadi entendía que matar va más allá del propio acto. Algunos asesinatos viven más que el asesino, pero solo cuando se hace bien.
undefined (Thai): ราธา อะซาิเข้าใจว่าการฆาตกรรมเหนือไปกว่าการลงมือ การ\r\nฆาตกรรมบางอย่างอยู่ได้นานกว่าผู้ลงมือ แต่ต้องลงมือถูกวิธีเท่านั้น
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 菈妲深諳如何讓死亡昇華為刻骨銘心而永垂不朽的藝術。

string_8: \"Anywhere else, you'd kill from the shadows. But this is Trarthus - so we shout murder from the rooftops.\" - Ratha Azadi
undefined (French): « Partout ailleurs, on assassine depuis les ombres. Mais nous sommes à Trarthus. Ici, on le crie sur tous les toits. » — Ratha Azadi
undefined (German): \"An anderen Orten tötet man aus den Schatten. Aber das hier ist Trarthus - wir präsentieren unsere Morde in der Öffentlichkeit.\" - Ratha Azadi
undefined (Japanese): \"Anywhere else, you'd kill from the shadows. But this is Trarthus - so we shout murder from the rooftops.\" - Ratha Azadi
undefined (Korean): \"다른 곳에서라면 그림자 속에서 살해할 것이다. 하지만 이곳은 트라투스다. 그렇기에 우리는 지붕 위에서 살해를 외친다.\" - 라타 아자디
undefined (Portuguese): \"Em qualquer outro lugar, a morte viria das sombras. Mas aqui é Trarthus, anunciamos o assassinato dos telhados.\" - Ratha
undefined (Russian): \"Anywhere else, you'd kill from the shadows. But this is Trarthus - so we shout murder from the rooftops.\" - Ratha Azadi
undefined (Spanish): \"En cualquier otro lugar, matarías desde las sombras. Pero esto es Trarthus, así que aquí lo gritamos a los cuatro vientos\". - Ratha Azadi
undefined (Thai): \"ถ้าเป็นที่อื่นๆ ก็คงลอบฆ่าในเงามืด แต่ที่นี่ทาร์ทัส เราเลยตะโกนบน\r\nหลังคาว่าจะฆ่าให้รู้กัน\" - ราธา อะซาดิ
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 「在其他地方，奪人性命或許該從暗處下手。在特拉特斯，我們從對方頭頂宣告死期將屆。」- 菈妲．愛札丁

string_8: Would-be sadists flocked to House Azadi, seeking kin in their band of killers. But only a select few rose above the chaff.
undefined (French): Les sadiques en herbe affluèrent auprès de la Maison Azadi en quête de leurs semblables, mais seul le haut de ce panier d'assassins eut l'honneur d'être accepté.
undefined (German): Möchtegern-Sadisten strömten zu Haus Azadi, auf der Suche nach Gleichgesinnten in seiner Bande von Mördern. Aber nur einige wenige Auserwählte trennten sich von der Spreu.
undefined (Japanese): Would-be sadists flocked to House Azadi, seeking kin in their band of killers. But only a select few rose above the chaff.
undefined (Korean): 가학적인 자들이 아자디 가문의 살인자 집단에게 동류의식을 느끼고 그들에게 모여들었다. 하지만 그중 소수만이 쭉정이들 사이에서 두각을 드러냈다.
undefined (Portuguese): Sádicos em potencial corriam para a casa Azadi para se juntarem ao bando. No entanto, só alguns se destacavam.
undefined (Russian): Would-be sadists flocked to House Azadi, seeking kin in their band of killers. But only a select few rose above the chaff.
undefined (Spanish): Los aspirantes a sádicos acudieron en masa a la Casa Azadi, buscando gente afín en su banda de asesinos. Pero solo unos pocos elegidos se alzaron por encima de la escoria.
undefined (Thai): คนที่คิดว่าตนเป็นคนซาดิสม์กรูกันเข้าไปที่บ้านอะซาดิ แสวงหา\r\nพรรคพวกในกลุ่มนักฆ่า แต่มีไม่กี่คนที่โดดเด่นเหนือกว่าผู้อื่น
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 愛札丁家族聚集了諸多有志成為虐殺者的變態人士，但只有少數人能脫穎而出。

string_8: Among Azadi's best, the mark mattered less than the method. To kill without flair was crude - commonplace.
undefined (French): Au sein de l'élite des Azadi, la victime avait moins d'importance que la méthode. Un assassinat sans élégance était à la portée du premier venu.
undefined (German): Unter den Besten aus Haus Azadi war das Ziel weniger wichtig als die Methode. Ein Mord ohne Stil war ungehobelt - gewöhnlich.
undefined (Japanese): Among Azadi's best, the mark mattered less than the method. To kill without flair was crude - commonplace.
undefined (Korean): 아자디 최고의 인재에게는 표적보다는 방법이 중요했다. 멋 없이 죽인다는 건 조야하고 진부한 일이었다.
undefined (Portuguese): Entre os melhores de Azadi, o alvo era só um detalhe. Matar sem estilo era considerado tosco e coisa de amador.
undefined (Russian): Among Azadi's best, the mark mattered less than the method. To kill without flair was crude - commonplace.
undefined (Spanish): Entre los mejores de Azadi, la huella importaba menos que el método. Matar sin estilo era algo de brutos, algo ordinario.
undefined (Thai): สำหรับคนที่เก่งกาจของอะซาดิ เป้าหมายมีค่าน้อยกว่าวิธีการ\r\nการฆ่าอย่างไร้รสนิยมนั้นช่างหยาบและดาษดื่น
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 對於愛札丁家族最出色的殺手而言，「辦事」的手段遠比刺殺目標更讓人津津樂道。

string_8: A name etched in blood is still a name. Many Azadins died trying to earn theirs.
undefined (French): Un nom gravé dans le sang reste un nom. Nombre des Azadi moururent en tentant de mériter le leur.
undefined (German): Ein Name, geschrieben in Blut, ist immer noch ein Name. Viele Azadi starben bei dem Versuch, sich ihren zu machen.
undefined (Japanese): A name etched in blood is still a name. Many Azadins died trying to earn theirs.
undefined (Korean): 피로 새겨진 이름도 이름이다. 많은 아자디 가문 사람들이 이름을 알리려다 죽어 갔다.
undefined (Portuguese): Um nome escrito com sangue ainda é um nome. Muitos azadinos morreram tentando conquistar o seu.
undefined (Russian): A name etched in blood is still a name. Many Azadins died trying to earn theirs.
undefined (Spanish): Un nombre grabado en sangre sigue siendo un nombre. Muchos Azadi murieron intentando ganarse el suyo.
undefined (Thai): ชื่อที่จารไว้ด้วยเลือดก็ยังเป็นชื่อ คนบ้านอะซาดิหลายคนตายขณะที่\r\nพยายามสร้างชื่อให้ตนเอง
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 當殺手的雙手沾滿鮮血，他們的名號也能傳遍大街小巷，愛札丁家族的殺手們為此前仆後繼地賠上性命也再所不惜。

string_8: Azadi's finest were known for rivalry as much as skill. On one occasion, both died trying to outdo the other - while their mark fled.
undefined (French): Les membres d'élite des Azadi étaient aussi célèbres pour leur rivalité que pour leur talent. En une occasion, deux d'entre eux moururent en essayant de se surpasser l'un l'autre, tandis que leur victime s'enfuit.
undefined (German): Die besten Azadi waren für ihre Rivalität ebenso berühmt wie für ihre Fertigkeiten. Einmal starben zwei bei dem Versuch, sich gegenseitig zu übertreffen - während ihr Ziel entkam.
undefined (Japanese): Azadi's finest were known for rivalry as much as skill. On one occasion, both died trying to outdo the other - while their mark fled.
undefined (Korean): 아자디 최고의 인재는 실력뿐 아니라 경쟁 의식으로도 유명하다. 한 번은 둘이 서로 이겨 먹으려다가 둘 다 죽고 표적은 도망친 적도 있었다.
undefined (Portuguese): Os melhores de Azadi eram conhecidos tanto pela rivalidade quanto pela habilidade. Já aconteceu de o alvo escapar enquanto dois se matavam tentando se superar.
undefined (Russian): Azadi's finest were known for rivalry as much as skill. On one occasion, both died trying to outdo the other - while their mark fled.
undefined (Spanish): Los mejores de Azadi eran conocidos por su rivalidad tanto como por sus habilidades. En una ocasión, ambos murieron tratando de superar al otro, mientras su presa huía.
undefined (Thai): อะซาดิยอดฝีมือมีชื่อทั้งในเรื่องความชิงดีชิงเด่นและความชำนาญ\r\nมีครั้งหนึ่งที่สองคนประชันฝีมือกันจนตาย... ขณะที่เป้าหมายหนีไปได้
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 愛札丁家族最為優異的殺手彼此之間競爭激烈，技巧的比拼尤甚。曾有兩名殺手為了一較高下而同歸於盡，他們的目標因而逃過一劫。

string_8: Audacious though they may be, Azadins don't advertise. They let their work speak for itself.
undefined (French): Aussi audacieux qu'ils puissent être, les Azadi ne cherchent pas à étendre leur réputation. Ils préfèrent laisser leurs œuvres s'en charger.
undefined (German): So kühn sie auch sind, machen die Azadi doch keine Werbung. Sie lassen ihre Werke für sich sprechen.
undefined (Japanese): Audacious though they may be, Azadins don't advertise. They let their work speak for itself.
undefined (Korean): 아자디 가문 사람들은 호기롭지만 광고는 하지 않는다. 일 처리를 통해 보여 줄 뿐.
undefined (Portuguese): Eles são ousados, é verdade, mas os azadinos não se vendem. Deixam o trabalho falar por eles.
undefined (Russian): Audacious though they may be, Azadins don't advertise. They let their work speak for itself.
undefined (Spanish): Aunque son muy osados, los Azadi no se promocionan. Dejan que su trabajo hable por sí mismo.
undefined (Thai): ไม่ว่าคนบ้านอะซาดิจะหาญกล้าเพียงใด แต่พวกเขาไม่โฆษณาตัวเอง\r\nเพียงแต่ให้ผลงานแสดงให้เห็นเป็นที่ประจักษ์เท่านั้น
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 作風大膽的愛札丁家族從不宣揚他們的戰果，而是由諸多「作品」展現他們過人的技藝。

string_8: Failure rang loudest of all. A botched kill meant the replacement made an example - of both target and Azadin.
undefined (French): Rien ne résonnait plus fort que l'échec. Un assassinat raté donnait toujours lieu à deux meurtres en exemple : celui de la cible, et celui de l'Azadi.
undefined (German): Zu scheitern war die größte Schande. Ein fehlgeschlagener Mord bedeutete, dass der Nachfolger ein Exempel statuierte - am Ziel und am Azadi.
undefined (Japanese): Failure rang loudest of all. A botched kill meant the replacement made an example - of both target and Azadin.
undefined (Korean): 실패는 가장 큰 울림을 남겼다. 살상을 그르치면, 대타가 표적과 아자디 사람 둘을 모두 본보기로 삼았다.
undefined (Portuguese): Nada faz mais barulho que um fracasso. Se errar, outro aparece para mostrar como se faz, matando o alvo e o azadino sucedido.
undefined (Russian): Failure rang loudest of all. A botched kill meant the replacement made an example - of both target and Azadin.
undefined (Spanish): El fracaso era lo que sonaba con más fuerza. Un asesinato fallido significaba que el reemplazo daría ejemplo con el objetivo y el Azadi.
undefined (Thai): ความผิดพลาดจะกึกก้องยิ่งกว่าอะไร การฆ่าที่ไม่สำเร็จแปลว่าตัวแทน\r\nจะจัดการทั้งเป้าหมายและคนบ้านอะซาดิคนนั้นให้เป็นเยี่ยงอย่าง
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 刺殺失手往往會激起陣陣漣漪，愛札丁家族會讓接替的殺手不留活口。

undefined (German): \"Die vier großen Gründer konnten sich nie leiden und sahen auf die Laster der anderen herab. Es brauchte nicht viel und ihre hart erkämpfte Unabhängigkeit zerfiel.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"The four great Founders were only allies out of necessity. It didn't take much for their hard-won independence to fall apart.\"

undefined (Portuguese): \"Os quatro grandes fundadores só se aliaram por necessidade. A suada independência logo foi por água abaixo.\"
undefined (Russian): \"The four great Founders were only allies out of necessity. It didn't take much for their hard-won independence to fall apart.\"
undefined (Spanish): \"Los cuatro grandes Fundadores solo eran aliados por necesidad. No hizo falta mucho para que la independencia que tanto les costó conseguir se desmoronara\".
undefined (Thai): \"สี่ผู้ก่อตั้งผู้ยิ่งใหญ่เป็นพรรคพวกกันด้วยความจำเป็น ไม่นาน\r\nอิสรภาพที่ชิงมาได้ก็เริ่มล่มลง\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): \"The four great Founders were only allies out of necessity. It didn't take much for their hard-won independence to fall apart.\"

string_8: Azadi was last to rise among the major Houses. Where killing was common, no one paid for it  - until Azadi cornered the market.
undefined (French): Parmi les grandes Maisons, Azadi fut la dernière. Là où tuer était monnaie courante, personne n'en tirait profit ; jusqu'à ce qu'Azadi monopolise le marché.
undefined (German): Azadi war das letzte, das den Aufstieg unter die großen Häuser schaffte. Solange das Töten selbstverständlich war, bezahlte niemand dafür - bis die Azadi den Markt beherrschten.
undefined (Japanese): Azadi was last to rise among the major Houses. Where killing was common, no one paid for it  - until Azadi cornered the market.
undefined (Korean): 아자디 가문이 주요 가문 중에 마지막으로 흥했다. 살인은 흔했지만, 그 대가로 돈을 내는 자는 없었다. 아자디가 시장을 독점할 때까지는.
undefined (Portuguese): Azadi foi a última das grandes casas a ascender. Numa terra de matança livre e gratuita, foi ela que estabeleceu o preço desse mercado.
undefined (Russian): Azadi was last to rise among the major Houses. Where killing was common, no one paid for it  - until Azadi cornered the market.
undefined (Spanish): Azadi fue la última en alzarse de entre las grandes Casas. Cuando matar era algo habitual, nadie pagaba por ello; hasta que Azadi se hizo con el mercado.
undefined (Thai): อะซาดิเป็นบ้านสุดท้ายที่เป็นใหญ่ในบรรดาบ้านใหญ่ การเข่นฆ่าพบได้\r\nง่ายจนไร้ราคา... จนกระทั่งบ้านอะซาดิคุมตลาดนั้นได้
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 在各大家族中，愛札丁家族興起的時間最晚。人們不要命似地逞兇鬥狠時，買兇並不普遍……直到愛札丁家族樹立模範。

string_8: At first, anyone could kill for coin. House Azadi made the kill itself worth paying for.
undefined (French): Au début, n'importe qui pouvait tuer en échange de quelques pièces. La Maison Azadi a transformé le meurtre en véritable art méritant dédommagement.
undefined (German): Zuerst konnte jeder gegen Bezahlung zum Mörder werden. Haus Azadi verstand es, dem Akt des Tötens selbst einen Wert zu geben.
undefined (Japanese): At first, anyone could kill for coin. House Azadi made the kill itself worth paying for.
undefined (Korean): 처음에는 누구나 돈을 받고 사람을 죽일 수 있었다. 아자디 가문을 계기로 살해 자체가 돈값을 하게 되었다.
undefined (Portuguese): Antes, qualquer um matava por dinheiro. Azadi transformou a morte em um produto.
undefined (Russian): At first, anyone could kill for coin. House Azadi made the kill itself worth paying for.
undefined (Spanish): Al principio, cualquiera podía matar por monedas. La Casa Azadi hizo que valiera la pena pagar por el asesinato.
undefined (Thai): ตอนแรกใครก็ฆ่าเพื่อหาเหรียญได้ แต่บ้านอะซาดิทำให้การฆ่าคุ้ม\r\nค่าจ้างนัก
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 買兇原是任何人都能幹的勾當，愛札丁家族則是讓行兇演變為一門值錢的藝術。

string_8: Independent killers didn't last. Clients knew: hire Azadi, or become their next contract.
undefined (French): Les tueurs indépendants n'ont pas survécu longtemps. Les clients le savaient : si l'on n'engageait pas la Maison Azadi, l'on devenait leur prochain contrat.
undefined (German): Unabhängige Auftragsmörder hielten sich nicht lange. Kunden wussten: heuert einen Azadi an oder werdet ihr nächstes Ziel.
undefined (Japanese): Independent killers didn't last. Clients knew: hire Azadi, or become their next contract.
undefined (Korean): 독립적인 살인자들은 오래가지 못했다. 고객들은 알고 있었다. 아자디 가문을 고용하지 않으면, 그들이 맡는 다음 청부 계약의 대상이 된다는 것을.
undefined (Portuguese): Os matadores independentes não duravam. Os clientes que não contratavam Azadi entravam em sua lista.
undefined (Russian): Independent killers didn't last. Clients knew: hire Azadi, or become their next contract.
undefined (Spanish): Los asesinos independientes no duraban mucho. Los clientes lo sabían: contrata Azadi, o conviértete en su próximo contrato.
undefined (Thai): นักฆ่าอิสระไม่ได้อยู่ได้นาน ลูกค้ารู้ดี ถ้าไม่จ้างบ้านอะซาดิก็กลายเป็น\r\nเป้าหมายคนต่อไป
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 無依靠的殺手難以為繼。買兇者了解到：不讓愛札丁家族賺一筆，或許自己就會是下一幅藝術品的素材。

string_8: \"When palms need greasing, you go to House Bardiya. When heads need rolling, you send for House Azadi.\"
undefined (French): « Quand il faut graisser des pattes, c'est la Maison Bardiya que l'on va voir. Quand des têtes doivent tomber, c'est la Maison Azadi à qui l'on fait appel. »
undefined (German): \"Soll jemand geschmiert werden, geht man zu Haus Bardiya. Sollen Köpfe rollen, dann schickt man nach Haus Azadi.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"When palms need greasing, you go to House Bardiya. When heads need rolling, you send for House Azadi.\"
undefined (Korean): \"돈을 찔러 주어야 할 때는 바르디야 가문을 찾아가라. 머리를 베어야 할 때는 아자디 가문을 수소문해라.\"
undefined (Portuguese): \"Quando é preciso subornar alguém, Bardiya é a escolha certa. Mas, para execuções, ninguém é melhor do que a casa Azadi.\"
undefined (Russian): \"When palms need greasing, you go to House Bardiya. When heads need rolling, you send for House Azadi.\"
undefined (Spanish): \"Cuando hay que sobornar a alguien, vas a la Casa Bardiya. Cuando tienen que rodar cabezas, vas a la Casa Azadi\".
undefined (Thai): \"ถ้าอยากเกลี้ยกล่อมคนก็ไปหาบ้านบาร์ดิยา ถ้าอยากฆ่าแกงก็ส่งคน\r\nไปหาบ้านอะซาดิ\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 「錢的事情找巴迪亞家族，處理人命的事情則要找愛札丁家族。」

string_8: \"A masterful blend of audacity and discretion - that's the Azadi trademark. You'll know who made the kill, never who paid for it.\"
undefined (French): Un savant mélange d'audace et de discrétion, telle est la signature de la Maison Azadi. On saura toujours qui a frappé, jamais qui a commandité le meurtre.
undefined (German): \"Eine meisterhafte Mischung aus Kühnheit und Diskretion - das ist das Markenzeichen der Azadi. Ihr werdet wissen, wer den Mord verübt hat, aber nie, wer dafür zahlte.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"A masterful blend of audacity and discretion - that's the Azadi trademark. You'll know who made the kill, never who paid for it.\"
undefined (Korean): 과감성과 조심성의 절묘한 조합이야말로 아자디만의 특징이다. 죽인 자가 누구인지는 알 수 있지만, 돈을 댄 자가 누구인지는 절대 알 수 없다.
undefined (Portuguese): \"Azadi tem um estilo ousado e discreto. Todo mundo sabe quem matou, mas ninguém descobre quem pagou.\"
undefined (Russian): \"A masterful blend of audacity and discretion - that's the Azadi trademark. You'll know who made the kill, never who paid for it.\"
undefined (Spanish): \"Una mezcla maestra de audacia y discreción: esa es la marca de Azadi. Sabrás quién cometió el asesinato, pero nunca quién pagó por él\".
undefined (Thai): \"การผสมความกล้าหาญกับความรอบคอบเป็นแบบฉบับบ้านอะซาดิ\r\nเจ้าจะรู้จักคนลงมือ แต่ไม่มีวันรู้จักผู้ว่าจ้าง\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 愛札丁家族的事業講究過人膽識和謹小慎微的絕妙平衡。你不難發現殺手的身分，但絕對無法得知背後是何方神聖買兇。

string_8: Azadi's true currency wasn't coin. It was reputation. And reputation, once wounded, bled.
undefined (French): La vraie monnaie d'Azadi n'était pas l'or, mais la réputation. Une fois cette dernière blessée, elle s'est mise à saigner.
undefined (German): Die wahre Währung der Azadi waren keine Münzen. Es war ihr Ruf. Und der Ruf, einmal angekratzt, blutete.
undefined (Japanese): Azadi's true currency wasn't coin. It was reputation. And reputation, once wounded, bled.
undefined (Korean): 아자디의 진짜 화폐는 주화가 아니라, 평판이었다. 그리고 평판은 상처를 입으면 피를 흘렸다.
undefined (Portuguese): A moeda de Azadi não era ouro, mas reputação. E, quando sangrava, era pra valer.
undefined (Russian): Azadi's true currency wasn't coin. It was reputation. And reputation, once wounded, bled.
undefined (Spanish): Azadi no comerciaba con monedas. Si no con reputación. Y la reputación, una vez herida, sangraba.
undefined (Thai): เงินตราที่แท้จริของบ้านอะซาดิมิใช่เหรียญใด แต่เป็นชื่อเสียง\r\nการเสื่อมเสียชื่อเสียงจะตามมาด้วยการหลั่งเลือด
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 對於愛札丁家族，名聲遠比金錢來得更有價值。金錢可失而復得，名聲一旦受創，便難以挽回信任。

string_8: Azadi contracts came sealed in wax. To break the seal was to accept the mark - and the consequences of failure.
undefined (French): Les contrats arrivaient scellés à la cire. Si vous rompiez le sceau, alors vous acceptiez d'abattre votre cible, ainsi que les conséquences d'un possible échec.
undefined (German): Aufträge hatten ein Siegel aus Wachs. Das Siegel zu brechen hieß, ihn zu akzeptieren - und die Konsequenzen im Falle eines Versagens.
undefined (Japanese): Azadi contracts came sealed in wax. To break the seal was to accept the mark - and the consequences of failure.
undefined (Korean): 청부 계약서는 밀랍으로 봉인되어 도착했다. 그 봉인을 뜯으면, 표적을 받아들이고 실패했을 때의 결과도 받아들이는 것이었다.
undefined (Portuguese): Os contratos de Azadi vinham selados. Romper o selo significava não apenas aceitar a missão, mas também as consequências do fracasso.
undefined (Russian): Azadi contracts came sealed in wax. To break the seal was to accept the mark - and the consequences of failure.
undefined (Spanish): Los contratos de Azadi venían sellados con cera. Para romper el sello había que aceptar al objetivo, y también las consecuencias del fracaso.
undefined (Thai): สัญญาบ้านอะซาดิจะลงตราประทับขี้ผึ้งเอาไว้ การเปิดตรานี้คือการ\r\nรับเป้าหมายและผลลัพธ์ที่จะเกิดเมื่อล้มเหลว
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 工作合約以蠟塊密封。拆信即代表接受委託……以及失敗時的一切風險。

string_8: Each Azadi contract was coded - names obscured, motives buried. But the message was always the same: kill.
undefined (French): Chaque contrat était codé : les noms étaient dissimulés, les motivations enfouies. Toutefois, le message restait identique : « Tuez untel ».
undefined (German): Jeder Azadi-Auftrag war verschlüsselt - verborgene Namen, versteckte Motive. Aber die Botschaft war immer klar: Töte.
undefined (Japanese): Each Azadi contract was coded - names obscured, motives buried. But the message was always the same: kill.
undefined (Korean): 청부 계약서는 모두 암호로 쓰여 있었다. 이름은 가려 있고, 동기는 묻혀 있었다. 하지만 요지는 늘 똑같았다. 죽여라.
undefined (Portuguese): Os contratos de Azadi eram codificados, sem nomes, sem explicações. Mas a mensagem era sempre a mesma: matar.
undefined (Russian): Each Azadi contract was coded - names obscured, motives buried. But the message was always the same: kill.
undefined (Spanish): Cada contrato de Azadi estaba codificado: los nombres oscurecidos, los motivos ocultados. Pero el mensaje era siempre el mismo: mata.
undefined (Thai): สัญญาบ้านอะซาดิแต่ละสัญญาจะถูกลงรหัสเอาไว้... ปิดบังชื่อ ปิดบัง\r\nเจตนา แต่สารก็เหมือนกันเสมอ: ฆ่าทิ้ง
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 每份工作合約都經過加密……殺手無從得知買兇者的姓名與動機，但總能明確得知目的是置受害者於死地。

string_8: Some left trophies. Others left warnings. But all Azadins left a message: the job was done - and the debt had been paid.
undefined (French): Certains laissaient des trophées. D'autres des avertissements. Cependant, tous les Azadins laissaient un message : la besogne était accomplie, et la dette acquittée.
undefined (German): Manche hinterließen Trophäen. Andere Warnungen. Aber alle Azadi hinterließen eine Botschaft: Der Auftrag war erledigt - und die Schuld wurde beglichen.
undefined (Japanese): Some left trophies. Others left warnings. But all Azadins left a message: the job was done - and the debt had been paid.
undefined (Korean): 살인의 증거를 남기는 자도 있고, 경고를 남기는 자도 있었다. 하지만 아자디 사람은 모두 메시지를 남겼다. 일이 끝났고, 빚이 청산되었다는 것.
undefined (Portuguese): Alguns deixavam troféus. Outros, avisos. Mas todo azadino deixava um recado: missão cumprida, dívida quitada.
undefined (Russian): Some left trophies. Others left warnings. But all Azadins left a message: the job was done - and the debt had been paid.
undefined (Spanish): Algunos dejaban trofeos. Otros dejaban advertencias. Pero todos los Azadi dejaban un mensaje: el trabajo estaba hecho, y la deuda se había pagado.
undefined (Thai): บางคนทิ้งของ บางคนทิ้งคำเตือน แต่คนบ้านอะซาดินทุกคนทิ้งสาร:\r\nงานเสร็จแล้ว และมีการชดใช้ตามค่าจ้างไปแล้ว
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 愛札丁家族的殺手或留下戰利品或警語，但總是留下同樣的訊息：工作已完成……且債務已結清。

string_8: \"Everyone knows: renege on Azadi, and become their next target.\"
undefined (French): Chacun le sait : si l'on manque à sa parole envers la Maison Azadi, l'on devient sa prochaine cible.
undefined (German): \"Jeder weiß: Brich dein Wort gegenüber einem Azadi und du wirst zu seinem nächsten Ziel.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"Everyone knows: renege on Azadi, and become their next target.\"
undefined (Korean): 아자디의 뒤통수를 치면 그들의 다음 표적이 된다는 것은 주지의 사실이었다.
undefined (Portuguese): \"Todo mundo sabe que, se trair Azadi, vira o próximo alvo.\"
undefined (Russian): \"Everyone knows: renege on Azadi, and become their next target.\"
undefined (Spanish): \"Todo el mundo lo sabe: reniega de un Azadi, y te convertirás en su próximo objetivo\".
undefined (Thai): \"ใครต่อใครก็รู้ ผิดสัญญากับพวกอะซาดิเมื่อไร ก็เป็นเป้าหมายคนต่อ\r\nไป\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 所有人都深知對愛札丁家族背信，自己就會成為下一個受害者。

string_8: \"To last in House Azadi, you need to be dead inside - or skilled at making others so. Preferably both.\"
undefined (French): « Pour survivre dans la Maison Azadi, il faut être mort de l'intérieur, ou exceller à tuer les autres. De préférence les deux. »
undefined (German): \"Um im Haus Azadi zu bestehen, muss man innerlich tot sein - oder geschickt darin, es andere werden zu lassen. Am besten beides.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"To last in House Azadi, you need to be dead inside - or skilled at making others so. Preferably both.\"
undefined (Korean): \"아자디 가문에서 살아남기 위해서는, 내면이 죽어 있거나 남들을 죽이는 데 뛰어나거나 둘 중 하나여야 한다. 둘 다라면 더 좋다.\"
undefined (Portuguese): \"Só sobrevive na casa Azadi quem já morreu por dentro ou quem sabe como matar por dentro. Melhor se for os dois.\"
undefined (Russian): \"To last in House Azadi, you need to be dead inside - or skilled at making others so. Preferably both.\"
undefined (Spanish): \"Para durar en la Casa Azadi, tienes que estar muerto por dentro, o tener habilidad para hacer que otros lo estén. Preferiblemente las dos cosas\".
undefined (Thai): \"เจ้าจะอยู่ได้ยาวในบ้านอะซาดิก็ต่อเมื่อเป็นคนตายด้าน หรือการทำให้\r\nคนอื่นตายด้าน ถ้าทำได้สองอย่างก็ดี\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 「想在愛札丁家族混口飯吃，你必須泯滅良心，或是擅於取人性命，兩者皆是尤佳。」

string_8: \"In Trarthus, life is cheap. We made sure death wasn't.\"\r\n - Ratha Azadi

undefined (Traditional Chinese): In a House that prized spectacle, {0} Azadi offered none - only results.

string_8: \"Trarthans never forget a debt. When the Ezomytes rebelled against the Empire, even though centuries had passed, we came to their aid.\"
undefined (French): « Les Trarthiens n'oublient jamais une dette. Quand les Ézomytes se sont rebellés contre l'Empire, nous sommes venus à leur aide même si des siècles s'étaient écoulés. »
undefined (German): \"Trarthaner vergessen nie eine Schuld. Als die Ezomyten gegen das Kaiserreich rebellierten, eilten wir ihnen zu Hilfe, auch wenn schon Jahrhunderte vergangen waren.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"Trarthans never forget a debt. When the Ezomytes rebelled against the Empire, even though centuries had passed, we came to their aid.\"
undefined (Korean): \"트라투스인은 빚을 지면 절대로 잊지 않는다. 에조미어인이 제국에 반기를 들었을 때, 수 세기가 지난 후였는데도 우리는 그들을 도왔다.\"
undefined (Portuguese): \"Os trarthanos não esquecem uma dívida. Quando os ezomytas se levantaram contra o Império, séculos depois, nós os ajudamos.\"
undefined (Russian): \"Trarthans never forget a debt. When the Ezomytes rebelled against the Empire, even though centuries had passed, we came to their aid.\"
undefined (Spanish): \"Los trarthanos nunca olvidan una deuda. Cuando los ezomitas se rebelaron contra el imperio, aunque hubieran pasado siglos, acudimos en su ayuda\".
undefined (Thai): \"ชาวทาร์ทานไม่เคยลืมหนี้ เมื่อพวกเอโซไมต์กบฏต่อจักรวรรดิ ไม่ว่าจะ\r\nผ่านมาหลายศตวรรษ เราก็ไปช่วยเหลือพวกเขา\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): \"Trarthans never forget a debt. When the Ezomytes rebelled against the Empire, even though centuries had passed, we came to their aid.\"

string_8: \"Once our debts were paid to the Ezomytes and the Karui, we considered ourselves even. After that... well, might makes right.\"
undefined (French): « Une fois notre dette acquittée envers les Ézomytes et les Karuis, nous avons estimé que nous étions quittes. Après ça… disons que la force fait loi. »
undefined (German): \"Nachdem wir unsere Schulden gegenüber den Ezomyten und den Karui beglichen hatten, waren wir quitt. Danach … nun, der Stärkere gewinnt.\"
undefined (Japanese): \"Once our debts were paid to the Ezomytes and the Karui, we considered ourselves even. After that... well, might makes right.\"
undefined (Korean): \"우리는 에조미어인과 카루이인에게 빚을 갚은 후로, 그들과 동등해졌다고 생각했다. 그 후로는... 힘이 곧 답이다.\"
undefined (Portuguese): \"Pagamos o que devíamos aos ezomytas e aos karui, e as contas se acertaram. A partir dali... passou a valer a lei do mais forte.\"
undefined (Russian): \"Once our debts were paid to the Ezomytes and the Karui, we considered ourselves even. After that... well, might makes right.\"
undefined (Spanish): \"Una vez que hubimos pagado nuestras deudas a los ezomitas y los karui, nos consideramos a mano. Luego de eso… bueno, el poder otorga la razón\".
undefined (Thai): \"เมื่อพวกเราชดใช้หนี้ที่ติดค้างต่อพวกเอโซไมต์และคารุย เราเลยคิด\r\nเสียว่าหายกันแล้ว จากนั้น... อำนาจก็คือความชอบธรรม\"
undefined (Traditional Chinese): \"Once our debts were paid to the Ezomytes and the Karui, we considered ourselves even. After that... well, might makes right.\"

string_8: The Merchant Council gave Trarthus a mask of order. Those who can't wear it are cast out.
undefined (French): Le Conseil des marchands a donné à Trarthus un semblant d'ordre. Ceux qui refusent de s'y plier sont exclus.
undefined (German): Der Rat der Händler gab Trarthus eine Maske aus Ordnung. Die, die sie nicht tragen können, werden ausgestoßen.
undefined (Japanese): The Merchant Council gave Trarthus a mask of order. Those who can't wear it are cast out.
undefined (Korean): 상인 의회는 트라투스에 질서의 가면을 주었다. 가면을 쓰지 못하는 자는 축출된다.
undefined (Portuguese): O conselho dos comerciantes deu a Trarthus uma fachada de ordem. Quem não se encaixa, é descartado.
undefined (Russian): The Merchant Council gave Trarthus a mask of order. Those who can't wear it are cast out.
undefined (Spanish): El Concilio de mercaderes le dio a Trarthus una máscara de orden. Quienes no pudiesen usarla, serían desterrados.
undefined (Thai): สภาพ่อค้ามอบหน้ากากความเป็นระเบียบให้กับทาร์ทัส คนที่สวม\r\nหน้ากากนี้ไม่ได้จะถูกไล่ออกไป
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 商會給予特拉特斯一只秩序的面具，無法遵從者只能另尋他處。

string_8: Though they would not rule for years, the Bardiyans helped shape Trarthus - quiet power moving behind every deal and coin exchange.
undefined (French): Même s'ils n'allaient gouverner que bien des années plus tard, les Bardiyens ont contribué à forger Trarthus ; une influence discrète à l'œuvre derrière chaque transaction et échange de monnaie.
undefined (German): Auch wenn ihre Herrschaft noch in weiter Ferne lag, halfen die Bardiyans, Trarthus zu formen - eine leise Macht hinter jedem Handel und jeder Transaktion.
undefined (Japanese): Though they would not rule for years, the Bardiyans helped shape Trarthus - quiet power moving behind every deal and coin exchange.
undefined (Korean): 바르디야 가문은 오랫동안 통치하지는 못하였으나 지금의 트라투스를 만드는 데 이바지했다. 그들은 모든 거래와 주화의 교환 뒤에서 소리 없이 움직이는 힘이었다.
undefined (Portuguese): Mesmo sem governar por anos, os bardiyanos ajudaram a moldar Trarthus, um poder silencioso presente em cada acordo e troca de moeda.
undefined (Russian): Though they would not rule for years, the Bardiyans helped shape Trarthus - quiet power moving behind every deal and coin exchange.
undefined (Spanish): Aunque no gobernaron durante muchos años, los Bardiya ayudaron a darle forma a Trarthus. Fueron un poder silencioso detrás de cada trato e intercambio comercial.
undefined (Thai): แม้พวกเขาไม่ได้ปกครองหลายปี แต่คนบ้านบาร์ดิยาช่วยก่อร่างสร้าง\r\nทาร์ทัสขึ้นมา เป็นพลังเงียบเบื้องหลังข้อตกลงและเหรียญทั้งหมด
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 巴迪亞家族並無實際治理，但他們成功將自己的影響力擴及特拉特斯的各行各業。

string_8: The first Bardiyan vault was carved into Korathin's bedrock - long before the city rose above it.
undefined (French): La première chambre forte bardiyenne fut creusée dans les fondations de Korathin, bien avant que la cité ne s'élève au-dessus.
undefined (German): Die erste Tresorkammer der Bardiya wurden in den Felsboden von Korathin gehauen - lange bevor die Stadt darüber erbaut wurde.
undefined (Japanese): The first Bardiyan vault was carved into Korathin's bedrock - long before the city rose above it.
undefined (Korean): 최초의 바르디야 금고는 도시가 그 위에 들어서기 오래전, 코라틴의 기반암을 파낸 곳에 만들어졌다.
undefined (Portuguese): O primeiro cofre dos bardiyanos foi escavado no nadir de Korathin, muito antes de a cidade existir.
undefined (Russian): The first Bardiyan vault was carved into Korathin's bedrock - long before the city rose above it.
undefined (Spanish): La primera bóveda Bardiya se construyó en los cimientos de Korathin, mucho antes de la ciudad que luego se erigiría encima.
undefined (Thai): คลังบ้านบาร์ดิยาคลังแรกถูกขุดขึ้มาที่หินดานของโคราธิน... ก่อนที่\r\nจะมีนครอยู่เหนือที่นั่นมาเนิ่นนาน
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 早在科拉廷這座城市達到今日的規模之前，巴迪亞家族便已在基岩鑿出他們的首座金庫。

string_8: While the Keitans laid stone, the Bardiyans moved coin. One built a city in broad daylight. The other ran it from the shadows.
undefined (French): Pendant que les Keitiens posaient la pierre, les Bardiyens faisaient circuler l'or. Les uns bâtirent une ville en plein jour. Les autres la dirigeaient depuis l'ombre.
undefined (German): Während die Keita Steine bewegten, bewegten die Bardiya Münzen. Die einen erbauten die Stadt im hellen Tageslicht. Die anderen beherrschten sie aus den Schatten.
undefined (Japanese): While the Keitans laid stone, the Bardiyans moved coin. One built a city in broad daylight. The other ran it from the shadows.
undefined (Korean): 케이타 가문이 돌을 까는 동안, 바르디야 가문은 돈을 움직였다. 한쪽은 백주 대낮에 도시를 건설했고, 한쪽은 그림자 속에서 도시를 운영했다.
undefined (Portuguese): Enquanto os keitanos levantavam muros, os bardiyanos faziam o dinheiro girar. Um construiu a cidade à luz do dia. O outro, no escuro.
undefined (Russian): While the Keitans laid stone, the Bardiyans moved coin. One built a city in broad daylight. The other ran it from the shadows.
undefined (Spanish): Mientras los Keita colocaban piedras, los Bardiya circulaban dinero. Uno construyó una ciudad a la luz del día. El otro la gobernó desde las sombras.
undefined (Thai): ยามที่บ้านเคย์ทาวางหิน บ้านบาร์ดิยาก็เคลื่อนเหรียญ บ้านหนึ่งสร้าง\r\nเมืองกลางแจ้ง อีกบ้านคุมเมืองจากเงามืด
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 當凱塔家族操控奴隸築起城牆時，巴迪亞家族則四處調度財權。\r\n一方在陽光下建城，另一方則在陰影中維持城市的營運。

string_8: Before the wars, there was trade. Keitan muscle, Bardiyan mind. Neither trusted the other - but both saw profit.
undefined (French): Avant les guerres, il y avait le commerce. La force keitienne, l'esprit bardiyen. Aucun ne faisait confiance à l'autre, mais tous deux y trouvaient leur compte.
undefined (German): Vor den Kriegen gab es den Handel. Die Muskeln der Keita, den Verstand der Bardiya. Keiner vertraute dem anderen - aber beide sahen den Profit.
undefined (Japanese): Before the wars, there was trade. Keitan muscle, Bardiyan mind. Neither trusted the other - but both saw profit.
undefined (Korean): 전쟁이 있기 전, 교역이 있었다. 케이타의 근력, 바르디야의 지력. 어느 쪽도 상대를 믿지 않았지만, 양쪽 모두 이익의 기회를 보았다.
undefined (Portuguese): Antes das guerras, havia o comércio. Os keitanos usavam a força, os bardiyanos, a cabeça. Desconfiavam um do outro, mas contavam o mesmo ouro.
undefined (Russian): Before the wars, there was trade. Keitan muscle, Bardiyan mind. Neither trusted the other - but both saw profit.
undefined (Spanish): Antes de las guerras, había comercio. Fuerza Keita, mente Bardiya. Ninguno confiaba en el otro, pero los dos obtuvieron ganancias.
undefined (Thai): ก่อนที่จะมีสงครามก็มีการค้าขาย เคย์ทานมีกำลัง บาร์ดิยามีปัญญา\r\nไม่มีบ้านไหนไว้ใจกันและกัน แต่ต่างฝ่ายต่างเห็นกำไร
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 在商戰爆發前，家族間仍從事貿易：凱塔家族提供勞力、巴迪亞家族從事謀劃。雙方對彼此毫不信任……但仍認為有利可圖。

string_8: No two Trarthan forefathers were more opposed - in ideology or in temperament - than Ixan Keita and Quilon Bardiya.
undefined (French): Aucun précurseur trarthien n'était plus diamétralement opposé qu'Ixan Keita et Quilon Bardiya, tant par l'idéologie que par le tempérament.
undefined (German): Es gab keine zwei trarthanischen Vorväter, die gegensätzlicher waren - sowohl in ihrer Ideologie, als auch ihrem Temperament - als Ixan Keita und Quilon Bardiya.
undefined (Japanese): No two Trarthan forefathers were more opposed - in ideology or in temperament - than Ixan Keita and Quilon Bardiya.
undefined (Korean): 트라투스의 시조들 중, 이상 면에서나 기질 면에서나 익산 케이타와 퀼론 바르디야만큼 서로 반대되는 이들은 없었다.
undefined (Portuguese): Nenhum outro par fundou Trarthus com ideias tão opostas em termos de ideologia e temperamento quanto Ixan Keita e Quilon Bardiya.
undefined (Russian): No two Trarthan forefathers were more opposed - in ideology or in temperament - than Ixan Keita and Quilon Bardiya.
undefined (Spanish): No hubo dos precursores más opuestos, tanto en ideología como en temperamento, que Ixan Keita y Quilon Bardiya.
undefined (Thai): ไม่มีผู้ก่อตั้งทาร์ทานสองคนไหนที่ขัดแย้งกันทั้งในคติและนิสัย\r\nไปกว่าอิกซาน เคย์ทาและควีลอน บาร์ดิยา
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 沒有人能比伊珊．凱塔和奇隆．巴迪亞這兩位特拉特斯創始期的要角更加看對方不順眼，不論是在理念上或氣質上。

string_8: Keita and Bardiya's rivalry erupted across Trarthus - supply lines cut, coin vanished, and not a single soldier raised.
undefined (French): La rivalité entre Keita et Bardiya éclata dans Trarthus : le ravitaillement fut interrompu, l'or s'évapora, sans qu'un seul guerrier ne soit mobilisé.
undefined (German): Die Rivalität zwischen Keita und Bardiya überzog ganz Trarthus - unterbrochene Versorgungswege, verschwundenes Geld und das ohne einen einzigen Soldaten.
undefined (Japanese): Keita and Bardiya's rivalry erupted across Trarthus - supply lines cut, coin vanished, and not a single soldier raised.
undefined (Korean): 케이타와 바르디야의 경쟁 구도가 트라투스 전역에서 불거졌다. 보급로가 끊기고 돈이 사라졌으며 군인이 한 명도 육성되지 않았다.
undefined (Portuguese): A rivalidade entre Keita e Bardiya eclodiu em Trarthus. Rotas de suprimento foram cortadas e moedas sumiram sem que um soldado sequer fosse necessário.
undefined (Russian): Keita and Bardiya's rivalry erupted across Trarthus - supply lines cut, coin vanished, and not a single soldier raised.
undefined (Spanish): La rivalidad de Keita y Bardiya estalló en todo Trarthus: se cortaron las cadenas de suministros, se desvaneció el dinero y ni un soldado.
undefined (Thai): ความเป็นอริกันระหว่างเคย์ทาและบาร์ดิยาปะทุไปทั่วทาร์ทัส\r\nตัดเส้นเสบียง เหรียญสูญหาย ไม่มีทหารรับจ้างอยู่
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 凱塔和巴迪亞之間的競爭影響了整個特拉特斯，造成補給線阻隔、財源斷絕，也沒有士兵願意響應號召。

string_8: Keita demanded tribute. Bardiya and Azadi refused. The result: starvation, sabotage, and blood in the streets of Korathin.
undefined (French): Keita exigea son dû. Bardiya et Azadi s'y opposèrent. Il en résulta une période de disette, de destruction. Le sang se déversa dans les rues de Korathin.
undefined (German): Keita verlangte Tribut. Bardiya und Azadi weigerten sich. Das Ergebnis: Hunger, Sabotage und Blut in den Straßen von Korathin.
undefined (Japanese): Keita demanded tribute. Bardiya and Azadi refused. The result: starvation, sabotage, and blood in the streets of Korathin.
undefined (Korean): 케이타는 공물을 요구했고, 바르디야와 아자디는 거부했다. 그 결과로 코라틴의 거리에는 기아와 파괴, 유혈 사태가 횡행했다.
undefined (Portuguese): Keita exigiu tributo. Bardiya e Azadi se recusaram. Depois veio a fome, a sabotagem e o banho de sangue nas ruas de Korathin.
undefined (Russian): Keita demanded tribute. Bardiya and Azadi refused. The result: starvation, sabotage, and blood in the streets of Korathin.
undefined (Spanish): Keita exigió tributo. Bardiya y Azadi se negaron. El resultado fue hambruna, sabotaje y sangre en las calles de Korathin.
undefined (Thai): บ้านเคย์ทาสั่งให้มอบบรรณาการ บ้านบาร์ดิยาและอะซาดิปฏิเสธ\r\nเกิดความอดอยาก การบ่อนทำลาย และนองเลือดทั่วถนนโคราธิน
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 凱塔要求貢禮，但巴迪亞和愛札丁拒絕遵從。最後讓科拉廷餓莩遍野、暴力和血腥事件層出不窮。

string_8: Bardiya won their struggle with Keita. Coin proved more vital to Trarthus than all the slaves Keita could whip into labour.
undefined (French): Bardiya l'emporta dans son conflit avec Keita. L'argent s'avéra plus crucial pour Trarthus que tous les esclaves que Keita pouvait mener au fouet.
undefined (German): Bardiya ging aus dem Kampf mit Keita siegreich hervor. Es stellte sich heraus, dass Geld in Trarthus wichtiger war als all die Sklaven, die Keita zur Arbeit peitschen konnte.
undefined (Japanese): Bardiya won their struggle with Keita. Coin proved more vital to Trarthus than all the slaves Keita could whip into labour.
undefined (Korean): 바르디야가 케이타와의 투쟁에서 승리했다. 트라투스에는 케이타 가문이 채찍질하며 노역을 시킬 수 있는 그 많은 노예보다는 돈이 더 중했던 것이다.
undefined (Portuguese): Bardiya venceu a disputa com Keita. O dinheiro se mostrou mais valioso para Trarthus do que todos os escravos que Keita podia forçar ao trabalho.
undefined (Russian): Bardiya won their struggle with Keita. Coin proved more vital to Trarthus than all the slaves Keita could whip into labour.
undefined (Spanish): Bardiya ganó su enfrentamiento contra Keita. El dinero probó ser más importante para Trarthus que todos los esclavos que Keita podía azotar.
undefined (Thai): บาร์ดิยาชนะการต่อสู้กับเคย์ทา เหรียญมีค่ากับทาร์ทัสมากไปกว่า\r\nทาสทุกคนที่เคย์ทาเฆี่ยนตีให้ทำงานได้
undefined (Traditional Chinese): 最終巴迪亞在鬥爭中勝過了凱塔。事實證明，對特拉特斯來說，錢財比凱塔手下奴役的奴隸重要多了。

string_8: Bardiya's victory over Keita came at a cost. From that pyrrhic win grew the Merchant Council - cooperative in name, Bardiyan in truth.
undefined (French): La victoire de Bardiya sur Keita eut un prix. De ce triomphe à la Pyrrhus naquit le Conseil des marchands, qui était coopératif de nom, mais bardiyen dans les faits.
undefined (German): Bardiyas Sieg über Keita hatte einen Preis. Aus diesem Phyrrussieg ging der Rat der Händler hervor - dem Anschein nach kooperativ, aber in Wahrheit kontrolliert von Bardiya.
undefined (Japanese): Bardiya's victory over Keita came at a cost. From that pyrrhic win grew the Merchant Council - cooperative in name, Bardiyan in truth.
undefined (Korean): 케이타에 대한 바르디야의 승리에는 대가가 따랐다. 큰 희생을 치르고 얻은 승리의 결과로 상인 의회가 생겨났다. 이름만 보면 협력체인 듯하지만, 본질은 바르디야 가문의 것이었다.
undefined (Portuguese): A vitória de Bardiya sobre Keita teve um preço. Daquele triunfo nasceu o conselho dos comerciantes, algo com cara de união, mas com alma bardiyana.
